1: # 白金英雄坛说 - Godot 实现差距审计
2: 
3: > 审计日期：2026-05-31
4: > 审计范围：以 `docs/00_文档索引.md` 中的新版主文档为准，对照 `godot_project/` 当前 Godot 4 工程。旧版文档和旧原型目录已清理，不作为当前必须实现项。
5: 
6: ## 1. 当前实现结论
7: 
8: Godot 版目前是一个可玩的 Alpha 竖切：已经有主菜单、角色创建、连续世界地图、73 个结构化区域、区域探索度、世界地图到局部区域的进入/返回、局部区域相邻转场、局部区域到商铺内景的进入/返回、可互动地标/资源点、驿亭休整与危险野外伏击事件、发现面板、带 NPC/任务标记和点击选择的世界地图面板、基础目的地标记、带路线/耗时/费用/风险提示和基础风险结算的城镇/门派快速旅行、玩家移动、138 个 NPC、对话、教学、商店、背包、带命中/暴击/冷却/状态/敌人风格/掉落/首领阶段的基础战斗、71 个带前置门槛和后续提示的任务、七派各 3 段门派入门任务线、简化修炼、存档读档、江湖传闻/世界事件记录、半俯视 2.5D 阴影/道具投影/景深氛围层、对话世界导演与可选 LLM 后端，以及一批可运行的生成美术资源。`game_state.gd` 已完成 God Object 拆分，规则逻辑迁移至 11 个独立系统类。
9: 
10: 但它距离设计文档中的完整武侠世界还有较大差距。当前主要完成的是“能跑起来的主循环”，文档中的区域系统、剧情系统、复杂战斗、经济声望、NPC 关系、天气氛围、完整 UI 和大规模美术资产，大多还没有在 Godot 中落地。
11: 
12: ## 2. 文档边界
13: 
14: | 文档 | 当前状态 | 备注 |
15: |---|---|---|
16: | `00_文档索引.md` | 已同步 | 已切换为 Godot 主工程索引，并移除旧 Python/Arcade 运行链路说明。 |
17: | `01_worldview_and_factions.md` | 设定为主，少量落地 | 五城、七派、基础门派名已落地；已有轻量江湖传闻事件，势力关系、复杂动态事件、隐藏组织未落地。 |
18: | `02_map_design.md` | 部分落地 | 73 区域已压缩成一张连续世界图，并已登记结构化区域和探索度；已有世界到区域、区域到商铺内景的第一版转入转出，已有基础目的地标记、路线估算、旅费和城镇/门派快速旅行风险结算，还没有完整独立区域加载、传送阵、隐藏区域。 |
19: | `03_npc_design.md` | 大部分落地 | 当前已有 138 个 NPC，文档中 31 个核心/门派 NPC 已全部落地（含数据、位置、对话），暗影司反派和洛阳/长安/临安/山路扩展角色也已接入；已接入基础性格展示、好感、交互记忆、江湖传闻引用和对话世界导演，人物弧光、作息和关系网络仍未落地。 |

58: ## 4. 主要未实现项
59: 
60: ### 4.1 世界观与势力
61: 
62: - 七大门派已有名称、基础技能表、部分 NPC 分布和各 3 段入门任务线；门派历史、组织结构、门规、声望奖励、内部矛盾没有系统化实现。
63: - 中立势力没有实现：天机阁、铁血盟、药王谷、暗影司、血月教、龙门客栈。
64: - 五大城池的文化、经济差异、特色 NPC、隐藏区域、动态事件没有对应系统。
65: - 已有轻量江湖传闻/世界事件记录；还没有季节事件、随机世界事件、势力冲突事件和玩家选择造成的复杂世界变化。
66: 
67: ### 4.2 世界地图
68: 
69: - 当前世界层仍是压缩连续大地图，不是文档要求的 73 个完整独立区域场景。
70: - 已有区域 ID 数据结构、进入识别、局部区域模板、相邻区域路牌转场、数据驱动区域商铺清单、重点区域数据驱动地标/资源点，高探索隐藏线索入口、奇遇目标区域追踪入口和独立商铺内景；洛水河畔已补专属桥、渡口、茶棚、鱼篓、药草和桥下铜钱等探索/采集点，成都城已补天府药市、都江渠眼、竹廊茶肆、药摊药罐、竹篮酒食和水渠鱼篓等城池探索/采集点，都江古堰已补飞沙分水堰、鱼嘴石堤、古堰水工棚、渠边鱼篓、水工药箱和堰边散钱等水工探索/采集点，岷江河谷已补岷江索桥、河谷渡口、半崖茶棚、浅湾鱼篓、河滩药草和码头散钱等河谷探索/采集点，蜀道群山已补蜀道栈关、绝壁栈道、入蜀驿亭、崖缝药草、栈道补给箱和崖边散钱等山路探索/采集点，新都平原已补连片稻田、古道驿站遗址、竹林小径、田埂稻束、林间草药和古道散钱等平原探索/采集点，温江花田已补四季花田、花商小棚、古花农居所、花田花种、花田草药和花篮食盒等花田探索/采集点，西岭高原已补高原古寺、冰川洞穴、山顶神坛、高原草药、雪线寒石和雪莲旧株等雪山探索/采集点，青城山已补青城山门、问道石台、清溪小桥、松根药草、道童香囊和桥边散钱等道山探索/采集点，峨眉圣山已补金顶山寺、云海观台、舍身崖栈道、山寺药箱、云雾灵草和香客散钱等圣山探索/采集点，江陵城已补江防码头、旧战鼓台、楚商货栈、码头鱼篓、军需药箱和货栈散钱等城池探索/采集点；相邻区域路牌已显示方向、预计行路耗时和路况风险，并会在转场时推进时间、写入行路事件；局部入口已开始按进入、探索、采集、追查、追踪、前往拆分提示和舞台标记，区域内文字牌默认收起为当前聚焦入口显示，避免遮挡连续舞台画面；局部地图已按地貌和区域类型做第一轮差异化，所有区域都能通过专属或同类复用拿到横版舞台三层贴图，但还没有为 73 个区域逐一定制的正式地图布局和事件层。
71: - 武当山已补武当金顶、太极演武台、后山隐径、古松松脂、金顶仙草和香客平安钱等道山探索/采集点，并接入专属金顶道观横版舞台，不再只依赖普通山地复用。
72: - 三峡险滩已补瞿塘古栈道、巫峡云渡、西陵险滩、江滩鱼篓、峡畔草药和古滩遗物等水路探索/采集点，并接入专属峡谷急流横版舞台，不再只依赖普通河谷复用。
73: - 神农架已补神农百草谷、神农洞穴、原始林心、神农草药、神农山参和林间野果等森林探索/采集点，并接入专属原始森林药谷横版舞台，不再只依赖普通森林复用。
74: - 已有基础探索度记录、一次性地标奖励、每日刷新资源点、高探索隐藏线索、带指向区域的奇遇线索记录、目标区域追踪入口、完成状态和发现面板；首次探索地标、有效采集资源点、首次追查隐藏线索和首次追踪奇遇目标会推进区域探索度，跨过 25/50/75/100 会解锁一次性探索阶段并写入江湖传闻，HUD 和世界地图详情会显示阶段名，追查到的隐线会进入任务日志作为后续奇遇入口，并可从任务日志标记世界地图目的地；追踪完成后线索显示已追到且不再生成目标入口，安全区域已有余波文本，高危野外已有伏击战入口；还没有完整隐藏区域发现、区域称号、区域 Boss 解锁。
75: - 已有发现区域后的城镇/门派基础快速旅行、路线耗时/风险/费用估算、熟路探索加成、旅费扣除、旅行时间推进和高风险路线基础后果；区域准入限制已实现（通关文牒/商队路引/门派腰牌三种物品门控、任务完成门控、出发区域探索度门控，共 14 个区域带 access_rule），世界地图面板会显示准入状态和路线分段详情，野外旅行事件链已落地（发现旧迹/途遇路人/天候影响三类非战斗遭遇，按路线种子和天气触发，会给草药/银两/时辰损耗/气血损耗等反馈）；数据驱动区域连接图已落地（`data/region_connections.json`，73 区域 452 条连接，支持 road/water/mountain/forest/secret 五种连接类型），路线规划优先走显式连接、连接类型影响旅行成本（水路 +0.6 / 林道 +0.9 / 山路 +1.8 / 秘径 +3.0），隐藏入口通过 secret 连接表达（那迦派秘径需完成暗影眼线、逍遥宫水道需出发区域探索度 50%），世界地图详情会显示区域通路类型汇总；还没有传送阵。
76: - 已有大地图面板、HUD 小地图、NPC/任务目标标记、目的地标记、按城镇/门派/野外/线索的区域筛选和基础路线提示；任务目标标记已共享任务目标解析，NPC 坐标贴近区域边界时会回退到最近区域；还没有完整路线规划。
77: - 五大城池、主要城镇、七大门派已有第一版局部地图、相邻区域入口和商铺/功能入口模板；还没有按城市文化差异做完整街区、府衙、武馆、黑市、门派内部建筑和专属事件。
78: - 区域布局模板数据驱动化已落地（`data/region_layouts.json`，当前 12 个区域 32 条布局特征）：布局特征支持 fill（矩形填充）/ line（折线绘制）/ set（单格设置）/ bridge_patch（桥块）四类操作和 13 种瓦片类型，`GameData` 新增布局数据加载（`_load_region_layout_assets()`）与查询方法（`get_region_layout()` / `get_region_layout_features()`），`MapGenSystem` 新增通用布局执行器 `_apply_region_layout_features()`，城池（`_apply_city_identity`）/ 门派（`_apply_sect_identity`）/ 镇子（`_apply_town_identity` / `_paint_town_hamlet_details`）/ 野外（`_apply_wild_identity`）四类身份方法均优先读取数据驱动布局，无布局数据时回退到原有硬编码分支；新增区域只需在 `region_layouts.json` 加 features 数组即可覆盖默认生成逻辑；验证器已新增布局校验（区域存在性、op/tile 合法性、rect/points/pos/center 形状校验）。
79: 
80: ### 4.3 NPC 系统
81: 
82: - `03_npc_design.md` 中 31 个明确命名的核心/门派 NPC 已全部落地（含数据、位置、对话）：苏梦瑶、陈天行、赵无极、玄机子、花如玉、烈火、蛇王、太极真人、冰魄、逍遥子，以及第二批核心角色林婉清、张铁牛、李清风、王小二、赵德、李慕白、王铁山、孙小妹、周不通、吴连山、白素贞、铁面判官、柳如烟、周伯通、秦琼、貂蝉、苏文达、花无缺、铁手何、扁鹊、王婆、暗影杀手、天机道人、暗影、小蝶、毒蝎、寒冰、归云、蝎子、影、清风道长、玄冥、寒霜、烈焰、棋仙、暗棋。
83: - 已有 NPC 性格字段展示、对话关系侧栏、基础好感度、交互记忆保存、地图环境气泡、跨天传闻记忆扩散、基于世界状态/任务/关系/江湖传闻的动态闲谈，以及局部舞台服务/巡逻/书卷/采药/锻造/掌门/敌人轻量视觉活动提示；10 个核心 NPC 已有按主线任务完成进度分 3 阶段的上下文对话（共 90 条），会随剧情推进自动替换静态台词；核心 NPC 在玩家正邪值极端时显示正邪反应台词（40 条，善/恶阵营 NPC 反应相反），在玩家完成剧情抉择后涉事 NPC 会有抉择回应台词（12 条）；全部核心 NPC 均已有对话内容，9 名新 NPC 已有专属任务；还没有完整 8 维性格模型、人物弧光、日常作息和关系网络传播。
84: - 已有短期对话记忆、关系语气变化和任务/发现事件形成的江湖传闻；还没有救助、背叛、亲友死亡、声望变化后的复杂长期世界反馈。
85: - 城镇 NPC 模板已有少量抽象外观，但没有模板化作息、服务类型、可复用任务池。
86: - 敌人已有 brawler/brute/bandit_boss/assassin/beast/boss 风格 AI，但还没有文档中的山贼、流寇、邪教徒、野兽、精怪、朝廷鹰犬完整体系。
87: 
88: ### 4.4 物品与装备
89: 
90: - 当前 Godot 有 166 个物品，文档目标是 400+ 物品。
91: - 物品分类已有：武器、防具、饰品、消耗品、材料、任务物品、通行证、书籍、货币；仍缺毒药体系。
92: - 已有按物品 ID 记录的轻量装备耐久、战斗磨损、耐久阶段加成衰减和铁匠修理闭环；稀有度系统已实现（五档：普通/优秀/精良/史诗/传说），装备价格、出售折扣、掉落权重均按稀有度分级；背包和商店 UI 按稀有度着色显示，详情面板含稀有度标签；仍没有鉴定、独立装备实例、强化、镶嵌、套装、打造、炼丹、采集制作。
93: - 装备槽已实现六槽位：武器(hand)、头部(head)、身体(body)、手部(hands)、脚部(feet)、饰品(accessory)；装备替换正确移除旧加成/应用新加成，各槽位独立耐久和修理。
94: - 没有门派契合度加成和传说武器独特技能。
95: - 已有基础出售物品、批量买卖和当前会话回购；掉落表已实现稀有度权重分级（普通 50%/优秀 30%/精良 15%/史诗 4%/传说 1%）和按敌人风格筛选的材质/装备/消耗品三类掉落池；仍没有玩家间交易和隐藏宝箱。
96: 
97: ### 4.5 战斗
98: 
99: - 当前战斗以 1v1 回合制为核心，已有基础命中、暴击、冷却、状态、敌人风格、掉落和首领半血阶段，但还没有完整八阶段状态机。
100: - 23 个武学招式已全部接入 `SKILL_PROFILES` 数据驱动，含 MP 消耗、伤害加成、命中率、暴击率、冷却、护甲穿透、多段连击、状态附加和升级缩放。
101: - 五行属性克制已实现：physical(金)→internal(木)→ice(水)→fire(火)→physical 循环，克制 +25% 伤害，被克 -15%；敌人属性由门派自动推断。
102: - 已有冰冻、灼烧、中毒、流血、眩晕、迟缓、虚弱、破绽、守势 9 种状态；火属性攻击可破除冰冻并造成额外伤害。
103: - 吸血(按伤害比例恢复生命)和吸内力(按比例吸取敌人内力)特殊效果已实现，接入 `SKILL_PROFILES` 数据驱动。
104: - 暴击、命中、闪避已接入；格挡反击已实现(格挡率 8%+防御*0.05% 上限40%，格挡减伤50%，30%概率反击攻击力*0.3)。
105: - 连招体系已实现：7 组连招链(八卦掌→混元一气 +20%、混元一气→八卦刀法 +15%、落花剑→百花缭乱 +25%、太极拳→太极剑 +20%、雪山刀→寒冰掌 +20%、寒冰掌→雪崩 +25%、红莲密咒→血刃 +20%)，通过 `last_skill_id` 追踪，普通攻击/调息/战斗结束自动断招。
106: - 已有 brawler/brute/bandit_boss/assassin/beast/boss 风格 AI、回血、守势和半血阶段。
107: - 多阶段 Boss 系统已实现：4 个 Boss（神秘人、魔化和尚、无面君、暗影司影主）各有 3-4 个数据驱动阶段，HP 降至阈值时触发阶段切换，每阶段可提升攻击乘数、防御加成、附加自身/玩家状态、解锁专属招式（七星连环诀、伏魔金刚掌、千面幻杀、暗影绝杀），并有转场文案；战斗 UI 显示阶段进度指示器（阶段编号+进度圆点）。
108: - 门派 AI 决策树已实现：七派敌人各有 3 回合循环节奏——八卦门(蓄势→破绽→连环刀法)、花间派(飞花→百花缭乱→虚实步)、红莲教(焚天→烈焰掌→连环焚)、蛊门(蛊毒→噬魂→万蛊)、太极门(守势→借力→以柔克刚)、雪山派(寒冰→迟缓→雪崩)、逍遥派(随机变化云手/北冥/凌波/天山六阳)；有门派的敌人优先走门派 AI，无门派则回退到通用风格 AI。
109: - 已有危险野外驿亭伏击、区域遇敌选择和敌人掉落；还没有世界 Boss、持续刷怪、等级缩放和完整掉落表。
110: - 地形战斗加成已实现：山地/悬崖/峡谷/关隘→金(physical)、森林/花田/田野/山谷→木(internal)、水城/水乡/河流/运河/渡口/湿地→水(ice)、荒漠/温泉→火(fire)，攻击属性与地形亲和时伤害+15%；地形从当前区域数据自动读取。
111: - 阵型前后排已实现：四种阵型（先锋阵 2前1后、雁形阵 1前2后、方阵 3前0后、伏击阵 0前3后），前列敌人防御 +20%、后列敌人攻击 +15%；存活敌人不足 2 人时破阵、移除加成；玩家击杀当前目标后自动切换到下一存活前列敌人，前列全灭后暴露后列。阵型遭遇在危险野外驿亭（danger≥4）、高风险驿路（risk≥5）和奇遇伏兵（danger≥5）触发；战斗 UI 显示阵型名和全部敌人血条花名册，当前目标用箭头标记。
112: - 协作战术已实现：队友在玩家行动后、敌方行动前进行自己的回合；三种队友角色——攻击型(普通攻击+概率施加状态)、治疗型(优先治疗低血量队友/玩家)、护卫型(为玩家承受伤害)；队友数据由 `build_ally_list()` 按已完成任务解锁（洛阳余烬→苏梦瑶、暗影眼线→陈天行、武林夜议→赵无极仅 Boss 战），危险场景最多 2 人、Boss 战最多 3 人；敌方有 25% 概率转向攻击存活队友，队友阵亡后退出战斗；战斗 UI 显示队友血条花名册（含角色标签攻/医/守），结算面板汇总队友存活情况。
113: - 战斗 UI 已有敌人头像、武学图标按钮、敌我持续状态徽记、战斗日志、轻量浮字反馈和胜负结算面板；结算面板会汇总阅历、潜能、银两、掉落、任务完成、装备磨损和下一步提示；战斗舞台已有姿态线、武器高光、起手预警、多层气势轨迹、事件空气斩痕、近景气浪压迫带、重击爆裂环和首批角色动作帧切换；仍没有正式立绘、技能子菜单、全套战斗动画和水墨特效。
114: 
115: ### 4.6 修炼
116: 
117: - 已有独立 `CultivationSystem` 类，支持八内功修炼/运转、五轻功修炼/施展、八经脉开脉/冲穴与五阶大境界突破；境界乘数已接入 `recalculate_player_stats` 的全属性计算。
118: - 仍缺天象变化、悟道事件、走火入魔风险。
119: - 没有师徒传承、秘籍传承、顿悟传承。
120: - 技能面板不是技能树，只是列表升级。
121: 
122: ### 4.7 经济与声望
123: 
124: - 当前只有单一银两，没有文/两/金三种货币单位和兑换关系。
125: - 商店已有客栈、药铺、铁匠铺、布庄、市集、茶肆等第一批类型入口和内景，已支持基础买入/出售/回购、数量选择、批量交易、合计预览、装备保护、按品类/价格排序、店铺行情折扣、第一版地区/特产静态价差，并能在商店面板显示本地特产行情与询价方向；铁匠铺已有装备修理模式，可按耐久缺口扣银两单件修理或一键修理全部受损装备并恢复满耐久；进店会把特产价差写入货价线索和江湖传闻，任务江湖页会显示需携带的特产数量和交割目的地。货价线索已能在目标区域生成“询价/行情”入口，玩家必须带足对应特产才能交割，交割数量会按货物基础价值分档生成；完成后消耗多件货物、发放银两/阅历、交割收益和路线风险补贴，写入市场落点传闻，并持久化跑商履历、路线风险与商誉；商誉会给后续买入提供轻量折扣。但黑市、动态市场与套利闭环仍很浅。
126: - 没有动态供需、季节价格、事件价格和正式地区差价套利任务；当前货价线索只是跑商/倒卖任务的轻量闭环，已有按货值生成的多件交割、第一版商誉、履历展示、路线风险补贴和商誉折扣，但还没有真实商队库存、价格压力、压价谈判、商队遇袭失败后果，以及商誉影响黑市准入/NPC 信任。
127: - 没有拍卖行、黑市、钱庄、存款利息、贷款、钱庄信誉。
128: - 没有门派声望、城市声望、NPC 好感、名望等级。
129: - 已有正邪值影响系统：正邪值 clamp 在 -100~+100，剧情抉择与任务奖励统一走 `change_daode`，七阶正邪阶层判定（正气凛然/侠义心肠/…/罪大恶极），11 门派划分为正/邪/中立阵营，NPC 态度按正邪阶层×阵营查表，任务门槛支持显式 `min_daode`/`max_daode` 与“正邪不两立”自动拦截，HUD 显示正邪值，对话关系栏显示 NPC 态度；剧情抉择已补齐负向正邪值来源（断令处“倒戈投敌”-10、旧案处“赶尽杀绝”-15），使“歹毒狠辣/罪大恶极”阶层可达；五结局已接入尾声任务完成触发（正邪值≥80 正义/≥50 正派/±50 中立/≤-50 邪派/≤-80 邪恶），结局面板展示结局标题、描述与墓志铭；仍缺黑市准入（正邪≤-20）。
130: 
131: ### 4.8 剧情与奇遇
132: 
133: - 当前已有 40 个 Alpha 任务和一条可连续推进到影司总坛余波、旧案终册与两条尾声分支的主线开端，并已加入前置门槛、等级门槛、门派限制、旗标门槛、新手自动追踪、后续提示、任务完成传闻和武学奖励；但还不是文档中的五章主线。
134: - HUD 和任务日志已复用 `GameState` 生成的下一步指引，会优先提示主线/当前任务的目标人物、敌人或修炼/收集动作；HUD 会显示当前任务目标可标记提示、已标记目的地和路线摘要；HUD 底部操作提示已从单行文本改为分段快捷键操作栏，但这仍只是行动提示，不等同于完整路线导航和剧情节点图。
135: - 已有断令后和旧案终册后的剧情选择（含善恶双线分支与负向正邪值后果）、NPC 记忆和传闻后果；仍没有八阶段剧情架构、完整主线节点图和多段长期分支后果。
136: - 已有按多维度优先级判定的八结局（武林盟主/一代大侠/隐士高人/魔教教主/武林公敌/朝廷鹰犬/富甲一方/开宗立派）与结局面板，尾声任务完成后触发并锁定重复触发，同时保存 New Game+ 继承快照；New Game+ 机制已落地——主菜单与结局面板提供"开启新周目"入口，继承基础属性+5、金钱（上限2000）、潜能+30、已学技能列表，存档支持 ng_plus_count。
137: - 没有 50+ 支线任务、任务失败后果、任务时间限制。
138: - 已有隐藏线索追踪到目标区域的第一条奇遇链，安全区域能生成市井/山门/野路余波，高危野外能触发伏击战；还没有八大随机奇遇事件和权重触发机制。
139: - 七派已有各 3 段第一版门派任务线；仍缺门派声望、门规惩罚、内部矛盾、长期职位晋升和更长支线。
140: - 已有轻量世界事件记录、跨天世界脉动和事件连锁机制——高严重度（≥4）事件会自动安排 2-5 天后的连锁余波事件（任务完成→江湖余波、走火入魔→魔气扩散、悟道突破→同道来访等），通过 pending_chain_events 队列在每日脉动时触发；并已加入季节性世界事件（春社祭典/伏暑瘟疫/中秋论剑/寒冬赈济，按当前季节概率触发）；存档支持 pending_chain_events 持久化；仍没有 NPC 关系剧情、NPC 死亡剧情、世界状态不可逆选择。
141: 
142: ### 4.9 天气与氛围
143: 
144: - 当前已有时间和天气文字、昼夜光照色调、区域地貌色调、危险区域压暗、细雨/飞雪/薄雾/多云/雷暴视觉层，水乡、城镇、山地、花林、荒漠、温泉、雪山和门派气场等程序化动态氛围，并已加入前景树冠/屋檐/山雾/沙幕/低处暗影、局部舞台空气透视、光束和镜头暗角等景深层；季节系统已落地——春夏秋冬每 15 天轮转，各季节有独立天气概率权重和季节色调叠加，季节性世界事件按季节触发。
145: - 还没有 9 种完整天气参数和真实光照阴影。
146: - 没有全局光照、阴影、反射、雾效。
147: - 已有程序化雨雪雾、落叶、沙尘、飞花、雪光和门派气场视觉表现；还没有正式 GPU 粒子资源。
148: - 没有环境音效、3D 音效定位、动态音乐分层。
149: - 没有 `AtmosphereManager` 或对应 Godot 节点。
150: 
151: ### 4.10 UI
152: 
153: - 当前 UI 是可用的程序化面板，但不符合 `11_UI设计.md` 中完整的水墨国风规范。
154: - 主菜单已有可复用水镇灯火背景、存档摘要和游戏内暂停态入口；暂停菜单可返回江湖、保存当前进度、读取存档和切换声音，存档已能恢复世界地图、局部街区和商铺内景上下文，开局菜单不会再因取消键误入探索态；新游戏已有 5 段开场叙事面板（序章·下山），在角色创建后、进入地图前展示背景与首个目标引导；仍没有开场动画、章节入口和水墨过渡。
155: - 角色创建已有门派说明、属性预算校验、男女/门派玩家形象预览和开局派系技能提示；仍没有随机姓名和更完整的出身事件。
156: - HUD 已有区域信息、常驻小地图、当前目标、下一步指引、地图目的地摘要、最新江湖传闻和底部分段快捷键操作栏；左上常驻状态面板已压缩尺寸、降低遮罩强度并对长文本做省略截断，减少遮挡局部舞台；小地图在玩家进入街区时自动切换为局部视图，显示 NPC 位置标记（任务目标 NPC 金色高亮+名称、重要 NPC 白色、普通 NPC 暗色小点）和玩家位置，退出街区时切回世界地图视图；任务日志已有任务/江湖/人物分页，并会在摘要中显示地图目的地；仍没有技能栏、丰富状态图标和完整路线导航。
157: - 背包已有物品图标、详情预览、已装备标识、当前装备槽和换装差值提示；仍没有 6x5 网格、分类标签、拖拽、Tooltip、品质边框、自动整理。
158: - 技能面板已有武学图标和详情预览；仍没有门派技能树、节点解锁、技能动画。

160: - 商店已有商品图标、详情预览、买入/出售/回购模式、数量选择、批量交易、合计/收入预览、交易确认和已装备物品出售保护；仍没有排序和折扣。
161: - 战斗 UI 已显示敌人头像，并会按已学攻击类武学生成招式按钮；已加入敌我持续状态徽记、伤害/闪避/治疗/守势/二阶段轻量浮字反馈和胜负结算层，仍没有完整行动菜单、日志滚动和正式战斗动画。
162: - 没有锻造/炼丹界面、设置界面、存档管理界面；世界地图界面已有基础版、点击定位、区域筛选、快速旅行和路线/耗时/费用/风险提示，但仍缺完整小地图和完整路线规划。
163: - 没有响应式 UI 缩放、键位自定义、加载界面。

1: # 白金英雄坛说 - Godot 重构设计
2: 
3: > 目标：以 Godot 4 工程作为后续主线实现。旧 pygame/Python 原型已完成迁移和清理，不再作为运行时依赖。
4: 
5: ## 1. 工程边界
6: 
7: - `Godot_v4/`：本机 Godot 引擎目录，只放可执行文件，不放游戏代码。
8: - `godot_project/`：Godot 游戏工程，可直接用 Godot 打开。
9: - `docs/`：设计文档、实现差距审计和后续规划。

12: ## 2. 当前竖切目标
13: 
14: 第一版不追求一次迁完全部系统，而是先做一个可玩的 Alpha 主循环：
15: 
16: 1. 按 `docs/02_map_design.md` 压缩实现的世界大地图探索。

19: 4. `T` 交谈、向师父请教武学。
20: 5. `F` 挑战敌人，进入简化回合战斗。
21: 6. HUD 显示气血、内力、等级、银两和当前目标。
22: 7. 主菜单、角色创建、任务日志、背包、商店、修炼、世界地图、存档读档。
23: 8. 平安镇任务链到“英雄试炼”的阶段通关目标，接入“洛阳旧火/暗影书信/七派风声/暗影眼线/断令归卷/武林夜议”的主线开端，并加入七派各 3 段入门任务线。
24: 
25: 这条竖切已包含背包、商店、任务、门派修炼、七派入门任务线、区域探索、带 NPC/任务标记的世界地图面板、存档读档和基础 NPC/地图/物品/UI 美术资源。后续重点转向更长的门派晋升剧情、战斗招式和 LLM 对话。

```
76: ## 4. 系统拆分
77: 
78: - `GameData`：加载 JSON、门派名、技能名、NPC 台词、区域数据等静态数据。
79: - `GameState`：保存玩家数值、当前模式、已学技能、当前目标和区域探索度。
80: - `EventBus`：跨系统信号，避免 UI、地图、战斗互相硬耦合。
81: - `WorldMap`：按地图文档程序化生成世界大图、处理可通行判定、NPC 生成和就近交互查询。
82: - `LocalAreaMap`：承接世界地图进入后的城镇/门派/野外局部地图和商铺内景，负责区域内商铺入口、可互动地标、每日资源点、相邻区域路牌、返回世界入口、局部 NPC 摆放、地貌差异化布局和内景碰撞。
83: - `DiscoveryPanel`：展示地标、资源点和后续奇遇事件的标题、所在地、正文和奖励列表，替代只靠 toast 承载探索反馈。
84: - `AtmosphereLayer`：承接昼夜、天气、危险度和区域地貌氛围，已按水乡、城市、城镇、山地、花林、荒漠、温泉、雪山、七派气场等主题绘制动态叠层。
85: - `regions.json`：记录 73 个区域的 ID、名称、类型、压缩世界坐标、危险等级和描述。
86: - `PlayerActor` / `NpcActor`：只负责表现、移动和自身数据引用；地图角色优先使用生成后的透明 PNG，未命中资源映射时再回退到拆件绘制。
87: - `CombatSystem`：独立战斗状态机，后续可替换为完整门派招式系统。
88: - `HudView` / `DialoguePanel` / `CombatPanel`：UI 单独维护，不混进地图逻辑。
89: 
90: ## 5. 后续建设顺序
91: 
92: 1. 继续整理 `godot_project/data/`，让 NPC、区域、任务、物品和资源映射保持单一来源。
93: 2. 扩展 `systems/combat_system.gd`，补齐门派招式、状态效果、日志和战斗表现。
94: 3. 逐步拆出 `inventory_system.gd`、`quest_system.gd`、`cultivation_system.gd`，每个系统只暴露少量公共方法。
95: 4. 地图从当前程序化绘制逐步替换为 TileMapLayer 和正式 TileSet。
96: 5. 美术资产稳定后再继续推进水墨后处理、天气、昼夜、粒子和技能特效。
97: 
98: ## 6. 设计原则
99: 
100: - Godot 工程内数据以 JSON/TRES 为单一来源，避免把 Python 代码当运行时依赖。
101: - 场景负责节点组织，系统脚本负责规则，UI 脚本负责展示。
102: - 每次只迁移一条完整玩家体验，不按文件机械翻译。
103: - 原型可先用程序化图形，等玩法稳定后再换正式素材。
104: - 关键探索链路使用 `res://tests/playtest_smoke.tscn` 和 `res://tests/playtest_flow.tscn` 做自动游玩测试：前者覆盖世界地图、局部地图、商铺内景、NPC 分布、碰撞、相邻区域入口、可互动地标和 2.5D 遮挡层基础检查；后者实例化主场景，自动跑新游戏、进入平安镇、探索地标、进入商铺、与掌柜对话、打开交易、购买商品、出门、通过相邻区域路牌转场并返回世界地图。
105: 
106: ## 6.1 当前地图落地
107: 
108: - 地图尺寸：`96 x 72` tile，使用 `GameData.MAP_WIDTH/MAP_HEIGHT` 管理。
109: - 世界结构参考 `docs/02_map_design.md`：5 城、16 镇、45 野外、7 门派压缩到一张连续可走地图。
110: - 已实装地貌：官道、街市、商铺、城池、乡村、田地、山脉、雪山、森林、竹海、荒漠、沼泽、水乡、河流、湖泊、桥。
111: - 已实装地标标签：平安镇、洛阳、长安、成都、江陵、临安、八卦门、雪山派、红莲教、太极门、那迦派、花间派、逍遥宫等。
112: - 已实装区域识别：`data/regions.json` 登记 73 个区域，玩家移动时更新当前区域、探索度和危险等级。
113: - 已实装世界层 NPC 分层：大地图只显示敌人、野外/门派关键人物，并缩小世界层 sprite；城镇生活类 NPC 在进入对应局部地图后按区域坐标重排生成。
114: - 已实装世界地图面板：`M` 键打开，显示区域示意图、已发现区域、区域说明、NPC 标记、可接任务标记和当前任务目标。
115: - 已实装第一版转入转出：世界地图按 `E` 进入城池、城镇、门派、野外局部地图；局部地图中可进入客栈、药铺、铁匠铺、布庄、市集、茶肆等商铺内景，并可从内景返回区域街道、从区域返回世界地图，或通过相邻区域路牌直接转场到附近城池、城镇、野外和门派。
116: - 已实装第一批可互动地标/资源点：城池按地区特色生成旧宅、榜亭、码头、药市、战鼓台等；城镇、门派和野外按地形生成告示、练武场、山洞、药坡、浅滩、古碑等入口，首次探索通过发现面板展示正文和奖励，可获得少量物品、银两或阅历，并写入 `GameState.game_flags` 防止重复领取。
117: - 已实装每日资源点：城池、镇子、门派、野外会按地貌生成药草、鱼篓、食盒、矿点、香案供钱等资源入口，同日重复搜寻只展示已搜寻状态，跨天可再次领取少量物资。
118: - 平安镇作为起始镇落在北洛阳区域，新手镇 NPC、洛阳主线 NPC、镇东敌人与门派 NPC 已分层摆放，避免开局人群全部堆在洛阳中心。

121: 
122: - 已加入第一批文档核心 NPC：苏梦瑶、陈天行、赵无极、玄机子、花如玉、烈火、蛇王、太极真人、冰魄、逍遥子。

127: ## 7. 当前美术落地
128: 
129: - `tools/generate_godot_art_assets.py` 生成第一批 Godot 可直接使用的 2D 美术资源：20 张地图瓦片、99 张 NPC 地图 sprite、41 张参考级 NPC archetype、99 张 NPC 对话头像、16 张玩家门派/性别 sprite、45 张角色拆件 PNG、22 张物品图标、41 张武学图标、73 张区域场景背景、8 张 UI 资源；`tools/refine_world_tiles.py` 负责迭代当前运行时使用的手绘瓦片多变体，`tools/generate_world_prop_assets.py` 负责生成 2.5D 地图道具 PNG。
130: - `godot_project/assets/world/tiles/` 保存当前世界地图和局部地图实际使用的 20 类、80 张 96px 高采样瓦片 PNG；道路、水面、建筑、商铺、桥、竹林、山体等瓦片已强化为更接近国风仙侠地图的表现，并由地图节点使用 mipmap/线性过滤缩放到运行尺寸，再按坐标稳定选择变体以降低重复平铺感。
131: - `WorldMap` 已加入第一版伪 2.5D 表现：地貌边缘过渡、建筑/门派/山体高度叠层、`MapProp` 遮挡节点、世界层角色缩放和较远镜头，后续再逐步替换为正式 TileMapLayer/TileSet。
132: - `LocalAreaMap` 已从单一十字路模板推进到分类型布局：五城会生成多层街巷和街区，镇子会生成村舍、田地和中心空场，野外按水系/山地/林地/荒漠/平原生成河道、桥、山脊、林坡和驿亭，门派按七派气质生成庭院、水榭、雪岭、碑场或旗幡空间。
133: - `MapProp` 已补井、石灯、小船、旗幡、花树、石堆、碑龛等 2.5D 道具，并优先加载 `assets/world/props/` 下的透明 PNG 资源；资源缺失时才回退到程序化绘制，由世界地图和局部地图按地貌自动摆放。
```

```
214: ### 4.12 技术架构
215: 
216: - `game_state.gd` 已完成 God Object 拆分（从 2153 行降至 1412 行），背包、任务、修炼、经济、声望、剧情、氛围、战斗、记忆、快速旅行、地图生成等规则逻辑已迁移至 11 个独立系统类：`inventory_system.gd`、`quest_system.gd`、`cultivation_system.gd`、`economy_system.gd`（含声望）、`story_system.gd`、`atmosphere_system.gd`、`combat_system.gd`、`npc_memory_system.gd`、`fast_travel_system.gd`、`travel_planner.gd`、`map_gen_system.gd`。`game_state.gd` 现在作为 facade，通过实例委托模式调用各系统。
217: - `llm_director.gd` 作为 NPC 动态闲谈和后续 LLM 接入入口，轻量世界事件仍暂放在 `GameState`。
218: - 地图还不是 TileMapLayer/TileSet，后续正式美术接入会受限。
219: - 已有数据校验、smoke/flow/combat 头less 自动测试；还没有导出配置、性能基准和更完整的系统级回归测试。
220: - `10_技术架构.md` 已切换为 Godot 架构说明，后续需要随系统拆分持续更新。
221: 
222: ## 5. 优先级建议
223: 
224: ### P0：先把当前 Alpha 变成稳定可扩展骨架
225: 
226: 1. 把任务、背包、修炼、经济从 `GameState` 拆为独立系统。
227: 2. 给 Godot 数据加校验脚本：NPC 坐标可通行、商品引用存在、任务目标存在、技能 ID 存在。
228: 3. 增加世界地图数据层：区域 ID、区域类型、所属城市、探索状态、进入触发。
229: 4. 补一份 Godot 专用 backlog，让 `13_Godot重构设计.md` 和本审计文档成为实现依据。
230: 
231: ### P1：补“真正武侠世界”的关键体验
232: 
233: 1. 在已完成的世界到局部区域转入转出基础上，为 5 大城、16 镇、45 野外、7 门派分批补定制布局、区域事件、资源点和隐藏入口。
234: 2. 按 `03_npc_design.md` 落地核心 NPC 第一批：苏梦瑶、陈天行、玄机子、太极真人、逍遥子等。
235: 3. 七派入门和门派任务线第一轮已完成，每个门派至少 3 个任务；后续应补门派声望、晋升和内部冲突。
236: 4. 扩展战斗招式系统：23 个招式已数据驱动（含 MP/冷却/伤害/状态/五行属性/连招/吸血/吸内力），五行克制、冰冻、格挡反击、7 组连招链、门派 AI 决策树（七派各 3 回合循环节奏）、地形加成（山地/森林/水乡/荒漠四类亲和+15%）、阵型前后排（先锋阵/雁形阵/方阵/伏击阵，前列防御加成、后列攻击加成、破阵移除加成、自动目标切换）、多阶段 Boss（4 Boss 各 3-4 数据驱动阶段、专属招式解锁、阶段进度指示器）和协作战术（任务解锁队友、攻/医/守三角色、队友回合插队、敌方转攻队友、队友花名册 UI）已全部落地。
237: 5. 世界地图面板、HUD 小地图、任务标记、NPC 标记、点击定位、区域筛选、基础快速旅行、路线提示、旅费和高风险路线后果已做基础版；区域准入限制（通关文牒/商队路引/门派腰牌/任务门控/探索度门控）、路线分段详情、世界地图面板准入提示、野外旅行事件链（发现旧迹/途遇路人/天候影响三类非战斗遭遇）已落地；后续需要加传送阵和更细的旅行限制。
238: 
239: ### P2：扩展系统深度
240: 
241: 1. 物品扩展到 166 个；稀有度（五档：普通/优秀/精良/史诗/传说）、六装备槽（武器/头/身体/手/脚/饰品）、掉落表（稀有度权重分级+敌人风格筛选）、出售折扣分级、材料物品 30 种已全部落地；背包/商店/战斗结算 UI 全量接入稀有度着色和标签。P2.1 已完成。
242: 2. 经济扩展：正邪×阵营价格系数（善店对正派优惠、邪店对邪派优惠）、掌柜好感折扣（30/50/70/90 四档）、门派声望系统（任务完成加声望、门派区域商店声望≥20/-5%、≥50/-10% 折扣、江湖页展示）、黑市雏形（洛阳黑市 NPC"鬼三"，正邪≤-20 准入）已全部落地；商店行情摘要显示所有折扣来源。P2.2 已完成。
243: 3. 修炼扩展：走火入魔风险机制（内力<30%突破时按缺口概率触发，分轻/中/重三档，全属性下降，按天数自动恢复）、悟道事件随机触发（打坐/战斗胜利时按地貌分类判定，六类悟道：观山/观水/观云/观星/战斗/绝境，永久累积 attack/max_hp/speed/crit/mp_regen 加成）、天象变化突破演出（五阶境界各有祥云笼罩/霞光万丈/雷劫降临/天地共鸣 天象 buff，按时长自动过期，每日 tick 检查过期）、师徒传承基础闭环（NPC 新增 teachable_arts 字段，拜师后同门派可学内功/轻功，八卦/花间/太极/雪山四派掌门已配置）已全部落地。P2.3 已完成。
244: 4. 剧情扩展到第一章完整主线和至少 10 条支线：第一章「初入江湖」主线桥接已落地（`q_main_choose_path` 择路江湖 → `q_main_faction_oath` 门庭初拜，通过 `has_faction` 旗标门控，衔接 `q_main_luoyang_ashes`），`_current_story_stage()` 新增「初入江湖·择路/门庭初定」阶段映射，`STORY_QUEST_PRIORITY` 与世界事件钩子已同步扩展；支线任务已扩展至 75+ 条（悬赏/护送/门派入室等），远超 10 条最低要求。P2.4 已完成。
245: 5. 天气和氛围已从文字推进到画面色调与程序化动效；季节系统（春夏秋冬四季，每 15 天自动轮转，按季节调整天气概率权重）、雷暴天气（程序化雨幕+闪电闪光+暗云压顶）、季节色调叠加（四色透明遮罩）、HUD 日期行显示季节、存档/读档支持 season 字段均已落地。P2.5 已完成。
246: 
247: ### P3：完整内容量与美术资产
248: 
249: 1. 生成正式 TileSet 和区域场景素材。
250: 2. 继续补全 UI 皮肤、武器装备图标、技能特效，并把已生成图标接入背包/商店。
251: 3. 补齐五城、七派、十六镇、四十五野外的场景差异。
252: 4. 实现多结局、New Game+、世界事件连锁。P3.4 已完成：结局系统从五结局扩展到八结局（新增朝廷鹰犬、富甲一方、开宗立派），判定改为多维度优先级（game_flag joined_court / money≥10000 / all skills mastered / daode 分档）；New Game+ 机制落地——结局触发时保存继承快照，主菜单与结局面板提供"开启新周目"入口，继承基础属性+5、金钱（上限2000）、潜能+30、已学技能列表；存档/读档支持 ng_plus_count 字段；世界事件连锁机制落地——高严重度（≥4）事件自动安排 2-5 天后的连锁余波事件（任务完成→江湖余波、走火入魔→魔气扩散、悟道突破→同道来访），通过 pending_chain_events 队列在每日脉动时触发，存档支持持久化；季节性世界事件落地（春社祭典/伏暑瘟疫/中秋论剑/寒冬赈济，按当前季节概率触发）。
253: 5. 隐藏入口系统化。P3.5 已完成：隐藏入口定义抽离为独立数据文件 `data/region_hidden_entrances.json`，与连接图（`data/region_connections.json`）解耦；`GameData` 新增隐藏入口数据的加载与查询方法；`FastTravelSystem` 中的 secret 门控逻辑升级为完整的多级门控（任务 required_quest / 物品 required_item / 探索度 required_source_exploration），且仅在 source→target 的所有连接均为 secret 且不满足门控时才阻断（普通连接存在时不阻断，修正了此前无普通连接时才强制门控的逻辑）；验证器新增隐藏入口校验（区域存在性、note 必填、quest/item 引用合法性、探索度 0-100 范围）。当前已有 6 处隐藏入口（那迦派/逍遥宫/神农架/黄山峰群/峨眉圣山/三峡险滩），支持单区域多入口扩展。
254: 
255: ## 6. 近期最合理的下一步
256: 
257: 建议下一轮不要直接继续堆 NPC 或美术，而是把已接入的“世界地图 -> 局部区域 -> 商铺内景”扩展成数据驱动区域系统。原因是地图、NPC、任务、奇遇、快速旅行、天气、资源点都依赖区域 ID；没有这个底座，后续内容会继续散落在坐标和硬编码里。
258: 
259: 建议具体拆成三步：
260: 
261: 1. 已完成 `data/regions.json`，把 5 城、16 镇、45 野外、7 门派全部登记为结构化区域。
262: 2. 已完成 `WorldMap` 当前区域识别，并在 HUD 显示区域名、探索度、危险等级。
263: 3. 已完成基础地图面板，显示已发现区域、区域说明、NPC/任务标记，并支持点击定位、目的地标记和城镇/门派快速旅行。
264: 4. 已完成第一版区域进入、相邻区域路牌转场、重点区域数据驱动地标/资源点、数据驱动商铺清单、商铺内景、基础路线估算、旅费和风险后果；数据驱动区域连接图已完成（`data/region_connections.json` + `tools/gen_region_connections.py`，五种连接类型、隐藏入口 secret 连接、连接类型旅行成本）；局部地图布局数据驱动化已完成并全量铺开（`data/region_layouts.json`，fill/line/set/bridge_patch 四类操作，73 区域 368 条特征已接入四类 identity 方法，5 城/16 镇/45 野外/7 门派全覆盖）；隐藏入口扩展已完成一轮（三机制并存：`regions.json` access_rule 扩至 20 ## 🎮 白金英雄坛说 — 开发进度总览
```

| 维度 | 状态 |
|------|------|
| **版本** | v0.3.2（Alpha） |
| **技术栈** | Godot 4.6 / GDScript |
| **审计日期** | 2026-05-31 |
| **总体评估** | ✅ **可玩的 Alpha 竖切，已具备完整主循环** |

---

### ✅ 已实现的核心内容

#### 世界与探索
- **96×72 连续大地图**，包含 5 城、16 镇、45 野外、7 门派，共 **73 个结构化区域**
- **连续世界地图 → 局部区域 → 商铺内景** 三层转入转出系统
- 区域探索度、发现面板、地标/资源点/隐藏线索/奇遇目标
- 快速旅行系统（路线耗时/费用/风险，区域准入限制，野外旅行事件链）
- 数据驱动区域连接图（452 条连接，5 种连接类型）
- 局部地图布局数据驱动化（`region_layouts.json`，73 区域全覆盖）

#### NPC 与对话
- **138 个 NPC**，所有核心/门派 NPC 已落地
- 对话交互（闲谈/请教/任务/交易/拜师/住店）
- NPC 性格/好感/记忆系统，江湖传闻扩散
- LLM 后端可选接入（OpenAI-compatible）

#### 战斗系统
- 1v1 回合制战斗，**23 个武学招式**数据驱动
- **五行属性克制**（金→木→水→火→金，+25%/-15%）
- **9 种状态效果**（冰冻/灼烧/中毒/流血/眩晕/迟缓/虚弱/破绽/守势）
- **7 组连招链**、格挡反击、吸血/吸内力
- **门派 AI 决策树**（七派各 3 回合循环节奏）
- **4 个多阶段 Boss**（3-4 阶段，专属招式解锁）
- **阵型系统**（4 种阵型，前后排加成）
- **协作战术**（队友系统，攻/医/守三角色）
- **地形战斗加成**（山地/森林/水乡/荒漠亲和+15%）

#### 任务系统
- **94 个任务**（主线+门派+支线+专属任务）
- **主线已推进到**：洛阳旧火→暗影书信→七派风声→暗影眼线→断令归卷→武林夜议→幕后暗主→血月残印→影司总坛→总坛余烬→旧案终册→**两条尾声分支**
- 七派各 3 段入门任务线，核心 NPC 专属任务
- 剧情抉择 + NPC 记忆 + 后续传闻差异

#### 修炼系统
- 8 内功、5 轻功、8 经脉、**五阶大境界突破**
- **走火入魔风险**（三档 severity）
- **悟道事件**（六类，永久累积加成）
- **天象变化突破演出**（五阶天象 buff）
- **师徒传承闭环**

#### 经济与声望
- 银两、商店（6 类商铺内景）、铁匠修理
- **正邪值系统**（-100~+100，七阶阶层，影响 NPC 态度）
- **门派声望系统**（折扣+江湖页展示）
- 跑商/货价线索/商誉系统
- **黑市雏形**（正邪≤-20 准入）

#### UI 与美术
- 主菜单、角色创建、HUD、背包、商店、修炼、任务日志、世界地图面板
- 战斗面板（全屏沉浸式战斗舞台）
- **水墨国风 UI 主题**（全局主题系统）
- **2.5D 画面层**：阴影/投影/Y-sort 遮挡/景深氛围
- **横版舞台三层贴图**（后景/中景/前景 PNG）
- DNF 风格整屏背景（清河镇/洛阳/长安/成都/江陵/临安 + 六类商铺内景 + 多个野外区域）
- 102 个 NPC 地图 sprite + 对话头像

#### 时间与天气
- 昼夜循环、**四季系统**（每 15 天轮转）
- 5 种天气视觉层（雨/雪/雾/多云/雷暴）
- 区域氛围色调、门派气场

#### 技术架构
- `GameState` God Object **已拆分为 11 个独立系统类**
- 自动化数据校验脚本
- **8 结局**（武林盟主/一代大侠/隐士高人/魔教教主/武林公敌/朝廷鹰犬/富甲一方/开宗立派）
- **New Game+** 继承系统
- 世界事件连锁机制 + 季节性世界事件

---

### ⏳ 主要未实现项

| 类别 | 差距 |
|------|------|
| **世界观** | 中立势力（天机阁/铁血盟/药王谷等）未实现；势力冲突/复杂动态事件缺失 |
| **地图** | 不是 73 个完整独立区域场景；传送阵缺失；部分区域缺定制布局 |
| **NPC** | 8 维性格模型/人物弧光/日常作息/关系网络未落地 |
| **物品** | 当前 166 个 vs 文档目标 400+；缺鉴定/强化/镶嵌/套装/打造/炼丹 |
| **战斗** | 缺完整八阶段状态机；缺完整敌人体系（山贼/流寇/邪教徒等） |
| **剧情** | 不是完整五章主线；50+ 支线任务缺失；随机奇遇未系统化 |
| **经济** | 缺动态市场/拍卖行/钱庄；只有单一银两 |
| **天气** | 缺正式 GPU 粒子/全局光照/阴影/雾效 |
| **UI** | 不符合完整水墨国风规范；缺锻造/炼丹界面 |
| **美术** | 当前资产 vs 900+ 总资产目标仍差很远；缺正式角色立绘/战斗动画/技能特效 |
| **音频** | 环境音效/3D 音效定位/动态音乐分层完全缺失 |

## 思考

No print/push_error/push_warning statements in the code - that's a good sign of clean code. The codebase is surprisingly clean and well-structured.

Let me now compile my assessment and create a roadmap. Let me think about the overall health:

**Code Health Summary:**

1. ✅ Data validation passes cleanly (73 regions, 139 NPCs, 166 items, 99 quests)
2. ✅ Godot headless starts and quits cleanly
3. ✅ Architecture is well-structured: Facade pattern (GameState) with 11 extracted system classes
4. ✅ EventBus for decoupled communication
5. ✅ Clean code - no debug prints or TODO/FIXME comments
6. ✅ Tests exist (smoke/flow/combat playtests)
7. ✅ Automated validation script

**Key Observations:**

1. **Strong Architecture**: The God Object decomposition into 11 systems is excellent. Clean separation of concerns.
2. **Data-Driven**: Almost everything is driven by JSON data files.
3. **Rich Content**: 94 quests, 138 NPCs, 166 items, 23 combat skills - substantial content.
4. **Good Testing**: Playtest smoke/flow/combat tests exist.
5. **The main.gd is 1331 lines** - it's the main controller and is getting large.
6. **local_area_map.gd is 4200 lines** - this is very large and could benefit from further decomposition.
7. **world_map.gd is 1968 lines** - also large.
8. **No audio system** - AudioManager exists but likely not populated.
9. **UI is functional but not final** - programmatic panels rather than true pixel-art UI.

**Recommended Phased Roadmap:**

Let me think about a comprehensive but realistic roadmap. The game is already playable with a lot of content. The next steps should build on the strong foundation.

Phase 0: Immediate fixes and stabilization (1-2 weeks)
- Fix any edge cases in existing systems
- Improve test coverage
- Performance optimization (large files)

Phase 1: Content expansion (1-2 months)
- Expand quests to 200+ 
- Expand items to 300+
- Add more NPC dialogue
- Complete the main storyline chapters

Phase 2: Audio system (2-4 weeks)
- BGM
- SFX
- Ambient sounds

Phase 3: Visual polish (1-2 months)
- UI skin upgrade to match水墨 spec
- More横版 stage backgrounds for remaining areas
- Character animations
- Particle effects

Phase 4: Systems depth (1-2 months)
- Dynamic market/economy
- World boss system
- Hidden areas
- Advanced NPC relationships

### ✅ 做得好的地方

| 维度 | 评价 |

| **架构设计** | 非常干净。`GameState` 已拆为 11 个独立系统类，`EventBus` 解耦，数据驱动（JSON 即数据源） |
| **代码质量** | 零 `print`/`push_error`/`push_warning`，零 `TODO`/`FIXME` 残留 |
| **数据一致性** | 验证脚本无错误通过（73 regions, 139 NPCs, 166 items, 99 quests, 460 条区域连接） |
| **Godot 启动** | 无编译错误，v4.7.2 头less 正常退出 |
| **测试覆盖** | 有 3 套自动测试（smoke 1527 行 / flow / combat） |
| **游戏内容** | 主线已到最终章+双分支结局，七派入门线完整，94 个任务，138 个 NPC |

### ⚠️ 需要关注的问题

| 文件 | 行数 | 问题 |
|------|------|------|

| `world_map.gd` | **1968 行** | 第二大，可以考虑拆地图生成和逻辑 |
| `main.gd` | **1331 行** | 主控制器，UI 组装逻辑和事件转发混在一起 |
| `game_data.gd` | **1978 行** | 静态数据都在常量和函数里，可以考虑拆成多个数据模块 |

## 🗺️ 分阶段开发路线图

### 🥇 Phase 1 — 稳定与体验打磨（建议优先）

**目标：让现有内容流畅可玩，不崩不卡**

1. **拆分大文件**
   - `local_area_map.gd`（4200行）→ 拆出区域渲染、商铺逻辑、地标管理
   - `world_map.gd`（1968行）→ 拆出地图生成器
   - `main.gd`（1331行）→ 拆出场景管理

2. **补核心体验断链**
   - 检查 94 个任务中是否有无法完成的死链
   - 完善七派晋升任务（现有只有 3 段入门）
   - 补齐战斗中状态效果的实际表现反馈

3. **性能优化**
   - 局部横版舞台的 NPC 降频绘制
   - 大地图角色缩放性能

### 🥈 Phase 2 — 核心内容扩展

**目标：让世界更满、玩法更深**

1. **剧情主线完整化**
   - 当前主线已近结局，但中间"七派风声→暗影眼线→断令归卷"之间还有剧情跳跃感
   - 补齐 5 章完整主线结构
   - 50+ 支线任务

2. **物品系统补全**
   - 166 → 300+ 物品
   - 毒药体系、锻造系统、炼丹系统
   - 独立装备实例（当前是按 ID 记耐久的轻量版）

3. **世界丰富度**
   - 补齐剩余区域的横版舞台专属背景（当前约 12 个区域有专属，还有 60+ 区域用复用）
   - 随机奇遇事件系统
   - 世界 Boss

### 🥉 Phase 3 — 感官体验升级

**目标：从"能玩"到"好看好听"**

1. **音频系统**
   - BGM 分场景/战斗切换
   - SFX（招式、拾取、交互、UI）
   - 环境音（雨、风、蝉鸣、市集）

2. **UI 美术升级**
   - 正式水墨国风 UI 皮肤（替换当前程序化面板）
   - 开场动画、章节过渡、水墨特效

3. **战斗视觉**
   - 替换程序化战斗特效为 GPU 粒子特效
   - 角色动作帧动画

### 🏆 Phase 4 — 终极深度

**目标：真正的动态武侠世界**

1. **动态经济系统**（拍卖行、钱庄、季节价格波动）
2. **NPC 关系网络**（8 维性格、人物弧光、恩怨情仇）
3. **势力冲突系统**（门派战、正邪大战）
4. **多结局完善**（已有 8 结局骨架，细化触发条件）

```json
{"file_path": "tools/generate_audio_assets.py", "content": "\"\"\"\n生成游戏音频资产（占位用程序化生成）\n- SFX: 简单的 WAV 音效（点击、命中、拾取等）\n- BGM: 简单的环境循环音效\n- Ambient: 天气环境音\n\n依赖: 仅 Python 标准库\n\"\"\"\n\nimport wave\nimport struct\nimport math\nimport random\nimport os\nimport json\n\n# ─── 配置 ───────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nOUTPUT_DIR = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(__file__)),\n                          \"godot_project\", \"assets\", \"audio\")\n\nSAMPLE_RATE = 44100\nMAX_AMP = 12000  # 避免削波\n\nMANIFEST_PATH = os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, \"audio_manifest.json\")\n\n\n# ─── 工具函数 ───────────────────────────────────────────\n\ndef _ensure_dir(path: str) -> None:\n    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)\n\n\ndef _write_wav(path: str, samples: list[float], amp: float = MAX_AMP) -> None:\n    _ensure_dir(path)\n    with wave.open(path, \"w\") as wav:\n        wav.setnchannels(1)\n        wav.setsampwidth(2)\n        wav.setframerate(SAMPLE_RATE)\n        for s in samples:\n            s = max(-1.0, min(1.0, s))\n            wav.writeframes(struct.pack(\"<h\", int(s * amp)))\n\n\ndef _write_ogg_placeholder(path: str, duration: float, note_hz: float = 220,\n                           style: str = \"simple\") -> None:\n    \"\"\"生成 WAV 作为占位 (Godot 支持 WAV, 此处使用 wav 扩展)\"\"\"\n    # 把 .ogg 替换为 .wav 以便 Godot 识别\n    wav_path = path.replace(\".ogg\", \".wav\")\n    n = int(SAMPLE_RATE * duration)\n    samples = []\n    for i in range(n):\n        t = i / SAMPLE_RATE\n        fade = min(1.0, t * 2.0, (duration - t) * 2.0)\n        if style == \"simple\":\n            s = math.sin(t * note_hz * 2 * math.pi) * 0.3\n            s += math.sin(t * note_hz * 1.5 * 2 * math.pi) * 0.15\n        elif style == \"drone\":\n            s = math.sin(t * note_hz * 2 * math.pi) * 0.2\n            s += math.sin(t * note_hz * 2.01 * 2 * math.pi) * 0.2\n            s += random.gauss(0, 0.02)\n        elif style == \"calm\":\n            s = math.sin(t * note_hz * 2 * math.pi) * 0.15\n            s += math.sin(t * (note_hz + 5) * 2 * math.pi) * 0.1\n            s += math.sin(t * note_hz * 0.5 * 2 * math.pi) * 0.08\n        elif style == \"tense\":\n            s = math.sin(t * note_hz * 2 * math.pi) * 0.25\n            s += math.sin(t * note_hz * 1.01 * 2 * math.pi) * 0.25\n            s += math.sin(t * (note_hz * 0.5 + random.uniform(-1, 1)) * 2 * math.pi) * 0.1\n        else:\n            s = 0\n        samples.append(s * fade)\n    _write_wav(wav_path, samples)\n\n\n# ─── SFX 生成 ──────────────────────────────────────────\n\ndef gen_sfx_ui_hover() -> list[float]:\n    \"\"\"轻柔的悬停提示音\"\"\"\n    n = int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.08)\n    return [math.sin(i * 600 * 2 * math.pi / SAMPLE_RATE) * 0.08 * (1 - i / n)\n            for i in range(n)]\n\n\ndef gen_sfx_ui_click() -> list[float]:\n    \"\"\"清脆点击\"\"\"\n    n = int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.06)\n    return [math.sin(i * 800 * 2 * math.pi / SAMPLE_RATE) * 0.12 * (1 - i / n)\n            for i in range(n)]\n\n\ndef gen_sfx_ui_confirm() -> list[float]:\n    \"\"\"确认音，两个上升音符\"\"\"\n    n = int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.2)\n    samples = []\n    for i in range(n):\n        t = i / SAMPLE_RATE\n        fade = min(1.0, t * 10) * (1 - t / 0.2)\n        hz = 500 + 400 * (i / n)\n        samples.append(math.sin(t * hz * 2 * math.pi) * 0.15 * fade)\n    return samples\n\n\ndef gen_sfx_ui_cancel() -> list[float]:\n    \"\"\"取消音，下降音\"\"\"\n    n = int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.15)\n    samples = []\n    for i in range(n):\n        t = i / SAMPLE_RATE\n        fade = (1 - t / 0.15)\n        hz = 600 - 300 * (i / n)\n        samples.append(math.sin(t * hz * 2 * math.pi) * 0.12 * fade)\n    return samples\n\n\ndef gen_sfx_typewriter() -> list[float]:\n    \"\"\"打字机音效\"\"\"\n    n = int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.04)\n    return [random.uniform(-0.06, 0.06) * (1 - i / n) for i in range(n)]\n\n\ndef gen_sfx_skill_unlock() -> list[float]:\n    \"\"\"技能解锁，上升琶音\"\"\"\n    n = int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.5)\n    samples = []\n    for i in range(n):\n        t = i / SAMPLE_RATE\n        fade = min(1.0, t * 8) * (1 - t / 0.5)\n        hz = 400 + 800 * (i / n)\n        s = math.sin(t * hz * 2 * math.pi) * 0.2 * fade\n        s += math.sin(t * hz * 1.5 * 2 * math.pi) * 0.1 * fade\n        samples.append(s)\n    return samples\n\n\ndef gen_sfx_hammer() -> list[float]:\n    \"\"\"打铁声\"\"\"\n    n = int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.3)\n    samples = []\n    for i in range(n):\n        t = i / SAMPLE_RATE\n        fade = (1 - t / 0.3) ** 2\n        s = math.sin(t * 200 * 2 * math.pi) * 0.25 * fade\n        s += math.sin(t * 400 * 2 * math.pi) * 0.12 * fade\n        samples.append(s)\n    return samples\n\n\ndef gen_sfx_item_pickup() -> int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.12)\n    samples = []\n    for i in range(n):\n        t = i / SAMPLE_RATE\n        fade = (1 - t / 0.12)\n        hz = 600 - 300 * (i / n)\n        samples.append(math.sin(t * hz     t = i / SAMPLE_RATE\n        fade = (1 - t / 0.2) ** 3\n        s = math.sin(t * 120 * 2 * math.pi) * 0.35 * fade\n        s += math.sin(t * 180 * 2 * math.pi) * 0.2 * fade\n        s += random.gauss(0, 0.02) * fade\n        samples.append(s)\n    return samples\n\n\ndef gen_sfx_combat_miss() -> list[float]:\n    \"\"\"闪避，风声\"\"\"\n    n = int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.15)\n    samples = []\n    for i in range(n):\n        t = i / SAMPLE_RATE\n        fade = (1 - t / 0.15)\n        s = random.gauss(0, 0.04) * fade\n        s += math.sin(t * 800 + 1200 * (i / n) * 2 * math.pi) * 0.06 * fade\n        samples.append(s)\n    return samples\n\n\ndef gen_sfx_error() -> list[float]:\n    \"\"\"错误提示，低沉嗡嗡\"\"\"\n    n = int(SAMPLE_RATE * 0.3)\n    samples = []\n    for i in range(n):\n        t = i / SAMPLE_RATE\n        fade = min(1.0, t * 20) * (1 - t / 0.3)\n        s = math.sin(t * 100 * 2 * math.pi) * 0.2 * fade\n        s += math.sin(t * 150 * 2 * math.pi) * 0.1 * fade\n        samples.append(s)\n    return samples\n\n\n# ─── SFX 清单 ──────────────────────────────────────────\n\nSFX_GENERATORS: dict[str, tuple] = {\n    \"ui_hover.wav\": (gen_sfx_ui_hover, \"UI 悬停\"),\n    \"ui_click.wav\": (gen_sfx_ui_click, \"UI 点击\"),\n    \"ui_confirm.wav\": (gen_sfx_ui_confirm, \"UI 确认\"),\n    \"ui_cancel.wav\": (gen_sfx_ui_cancel, \"UI 取消\"),\n    \"typewriter.wav\": (gen_sfx_typewriter, \"打字机\"),\n    \"skill_unlock.wav\": (gen_sfx_skill_unlock, \"技能解锁\"),\n    \"hammer.wav\": (gen_sfx_hammer, \"打铁\"),\n    \"item_pickup.wav\": (gen_sfx_item_pickup, \"拾取物品\"),\n    \"item_drop.wav\": (gen_sfx_item_drop, \"丢弃物品\"),\n    \"combat_hit.wav\": (gen_sfx_combat_hit, \"命中\"),\n    \"combat_miss.wav\": (gen_sfx_combat_miss, \"闪避\"),\n    \"error.wav\": (gen_sfx_error, \"错误\"),\n}\n\n# ─── BGM / Ambient 生成 ────────────────────────────────\n\nBGM_SPECS: dict[str, tuple] = {\n    \"main_menu.wav\": (18.0, 180, \"calm\"),      # 主菜单\n    \"explore.wav\": (24.0, 120, \"simple\"),       # 探索\n    \"combat.wav\": (16.0, 80, \"tense\"),          # 战斗\n    \"inn.wav\": (20.0, 160, \"drone\"),            # 客栈\n}\n\nAMBIENT_SPECS: dict[str, tuple] = {\n    \"sunny.wav\": (20.0, 400, \"calm\"),           # 晴朗\n    \"cloudy.wav\": (20.0, 200, \"drone\"),         # 多云\n    \"rain.wav\": (20.0, 100, \"tense\"),           # 雨\n    \"storm.wav\": (16.0, 60, \"tense\"),           # 雷暴\n    \"snow.wav\": (20.0, 300, \"calm\"),            # 雪\n    \"fog.wav\": (20.0, 150, \"drone\"),            # 雾\n}\n\n\n# ─── 主流程 ────────────────────────────────────────────\n\ndef main() -> None:\n    sfx_dir = os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, \"sfx\")\n    bgm_dir = os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, \"bgm\")\n    ambient_dir = os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, \"ambient\")\n\n    generated: dict[str, list[str]] = {\n        \"sfx\": [],\n        \"bgm\": [],\n        \"ambient\": [],\n    }\n\n    # --- SFX ---\n    print(\"🎵 生成 SFX ...\")\n    for filename, (gen_func, desc) in SFX_GENERATORS.items():\n        path = os.path.join(sfx_dir, filename)\n        samples = gen_func()\n        _write_wav(path, samples)\n        generated[\"sfx\"].append(filename)\n        print(f\"   ✓ {filename} ({desc})\")\n\n    # --- BGM ---\n    print(\"\\n🎵 生成 BGM ...\")\n    for filename, (duration, note_hz, style) in BGM_SPECS.items():\n        path = os.path.join(bgm_dir, filename)\n        _write_ogg_placeholder(path, duration, note_hz, style)\n        generated[\"bgm\"].append(filename)\n        print(f\"   ✓ {filename} ({duration}s, {note_hz}Hz, {style})\")\n\n    # --- Ambient ---\n    print(\"\\n🎵 生成 Ambient ...\")\n    for filename, (duration, note_hz, style) in AMBIENT_SPECS.items():\n        path = os.path.join(ambient_dir, filename)\n        _write_ogg_placeholder(path, duration, note_hz, style)\n        generated[\"ambient\"].append(filename)\n        print(f\"   ✓ {filename} ({duration}s, {note_hz}Hz, {style})\")\n\n    # --- 更新音频管理器路径 ---\n    _patch_audio_manager_paths()\n\n    # --- 写入清单 ---\n    manifest = {\n        \"generated_at\": \"tools/generate_audio_assets.py\",\n        \"count\": {\n            \"sfx\": len(generated[\"sfx\"]),\n            \"bgm\": len(generated[\"bgm\"]),\n            \"ambient\": len(generated[\"ambient\"]),\n        },\n        \"files\": generated,\n    }\n    with open(MANIFEST_PATH, \"w\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n        json.dump(manifest, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)\n    print(f\"\\n✅ 音频清单已写入: {MANIFEST_PATH}\")\n    print(f\"   共生成 {sum(len(v) for v in generated.values())} 个音频文件\")\n\n\ndef _patch_audio_manager_paths() -> None:\n    \"\"\"更新 audio_manager.gd 中的路径从 .ogg 改为 .wav（因为我们生成的是 WAV）\"\"\"\n    manager_path = os.path.join(\n        os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(__file__)),\n        \"godot_project\", \"scripts\", \"autoload\", \"audio_manager.gd\"\n    )\n    # 路径已使用 .ogg 和 .wav 混合，我们生成的 BGM/Ambient 是 .wav 扩展\n    # 不需要改代码，Godot 支持两种格式\n    print(\"   ℹ audio_manager.gd 路径无需修改（Godot 支持 WAV/OGG）\")\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()"}
```

## 思考

Audio files generated. Now I need to update the audio_manager.gd to use .wav extensions for BGM and ambient paths (since we generated .wav files instead of .ogg). Let me also update the paths.

Wait, looking at the audio_manager.gd again, the BGM_PATHS use .ogg extension and AMBIENT_PATHS use .ogg extension too. Since we generated .wav files, I need to update those paths. Actually, Godot's AudioStreamPlayer handles both .wav and .ogg, but the path needs to match the actual file.

Let me update the audio_manager.gd paths.

## 思考

Now I have a good understanding of the main.gd structure. Let me now create a comprehensive plan to integrate audio. I need to:

1. Add audio calls in main.gd for:
   - Mode transitions (menu → explore → combat → explore)
   - UI panel open/close sounds (already have some patterns)
   - Weather/ambient changes

2. The audio_manager.gd is already well-structured, I just need to call it from the right places.

Let me now add the audio integration to main.gd. The key integration points are:

1. `_ready()` - start menu BGM
2. `_start_new_game()` / `_enter_game_after_narrative()` - transition from menu to explore BGM
3. `_on_combat_finished()` - combat end → explore BGM
4. In combat system start - combat BGM
5. Weather changes - ambient sounds
6. UI actions - SFX

Let me look at more of main.gd first.

## 思考

I can see that main_menu_panel.gd already calls `AudioManager.play_bgm("main_menu")` in its `show_menu()` method. So the audio infrastructure is already partially wired up. Good!

Now I need to add the audio calls in the right places in main.gd. Let me now edit main.gd to add audio integration. The key things to add:

1. Start menu BGM when the game starts (the main_menu_panel already does this via `show_menu`)
2. Switch to explore BGM when entering the game
3. Play combat BGM when combat starts
4. Switch back to explore BGM when combat ends
5. Play ambient sounds when weather changes

Let me now make these changes. I need to add AudioManager calls at the key transition points in main.gd.

Let me identify the right spots:

1. `_ready()` - Already handled by main_menu_panel.show_menu which plays BGM
2. `_enter_game_after_narrative()` - Start explore BGM
3. `_start_combat_from_data()` and the combat start in `_handle_explore_actions()` - Play combat BGM
4. `_on_combat_finished()` - Switch back to explore BGM
5. `_open_dialogue()` - Play a SFX
6. `_return_to_world()`, `_enter_local_region()` - Location change ambient

Let me look at the combat panel to see where combat starts.

Actually, I see that combat_panel has `_on_combat_started`, `_on_combat_changed`, `_on_combat_finished` signals. The combat_system emits these signals. So I should connect to these signals in main.gd or in the combat panel.

Let me look at the combat_panel more - specifically `_on_combat_started` to understand when combat UI becomes visible.

## 思考

I can see the weather system. The weather is stored in `GameState.weather` and can be one of: "晴朗", "细雨", "飞雪", "薄雾", "多云", "雷暴" etc. The atmosphere_system handles weather. The atmosphere_layer draws visual weather effects.

I need to add ambient sound changes when weather changes. The `EventBus.time_changed` signal is emitted when the time/weather changes. Let me wire up the ambient sounds to the weather changes in the atmosphere_layer.gd, since it already handles visual weather rendering.

Let me now edit the atmosphere_layer.gd to add ambient sounds when weather changes.

## 思考

The atmosphere_layer is beautiful - it has rich procedural visual effects for weather and regional themes. Now I need to add ambient audio that changes with weather. I'll add `AudioManager.play_ambient()` calls in the `_on_time_changed` method when the weather changes.

Also, I need to add the weather-to-ambient key mapping. Looking at what the audio_manager expects: `AMBIENT_PATHS` uses keys like "sunny", "cloudy", "rain", "storm", "snow", "fog". But GameState.weather uses Chinese names like "晴朗", "多云", "细雨", "雷暴", "飞雪", "薄雾".

Let me add the mapping and wire up the ambient audio in atmosphere_layer.gd.

## 思考

The issue is that `WEATHER_AMBIENT_MAP.get(weather, "")` returns a Variant because `WEATHER_AMBIENT_MAP` is a `const` dictionary, but the `get()` method returns a Variant. So `var key := ...` infers the type as Variant, and then `key.is_empty()` on a Variant causes a warning which is treated as an error.

I need to explicitly type `key` as String or cast the result.

## 工具 · edit

```json
{"file_path": "godot_project/scripts/ui/atmosphere_layer.gd", "new_string": "func _update_ambient_audio() -> void:\n\tvar key: String = WEATHER_AMBIENT_MAP.get(weather, \"\")\n\tif key.is_empty() or key == _last_ambient_key:\n\t\treturn\n\t_last_ambient_key = key\n\tif AudioManager.has_ambient(key):\n\t\tAudioManager.play_ambient(key)\n\telse:\n\t\tAudioManager.stop_ambient()", "old_string": "func _update_ambient_audio() -> void:\n\tvar key := WEATHER_AMBIENT_MAP.get(weather, \"\")\n\tif key.is_empty() or key == _last_ambient_key:\n\t\treturn\n\t_last_ambient_key = key\n\tif AudioManager.has_ambient(key):\n\t\tAudioManager.play_ambient(key)\n\telse:\n\t\tAudioManager.stop_ambient()"}
```

## 思考

This is a very large file. It has ~150 functions. The main responsibilities are:

1. **Shop management** - `SHOP_DEFINITIONS`, `enter_shop()`, `exit_shop()`, `_load_shop_interior_background()`, `_spawn_shopkeeper()`, etc.
2. **NPC management** - `_spawn_region_npcs()`, `_spawn_npc()`, `_clear_npcs()`, `get_npc_markers()`, NPC tile placement
3. **Stage rendering** - All the `_draw_side_view_*`, `_draw_stage_*` functions (the bulk of the file)
4. **Portal management** - `get_nearest_portal()`, `_build_portal_labels()`, `_draw_portals()`, `_draw_stage_*_marker()`
5. **Overlay rendering** - `_draw_scene_overlay()`, `_draw_region_overlay()`, `_draw_shop_overlay()`
6. **Utility** - `is_position_walkable()`, `world_to_tile()`, `tile_to_world()`, etc.

The biggest chunk is the stage rendering functions (about 50+ functions). The most logical split would be:

1. Extract stage rendering into a separate file (like `local_stage_renderer.gd`)
2. Extract shop/NPC management into another file

However, for the refactoring to work without breaking things, I need to be careful. The key insight is that `local_area_map.gd` extends `Node2D` and draws directly to the canvas. The stage rendering functions are all just `_draw_*` methods that call `draw_*` primitives.

A simpler, less risky approach would be to:
1. Extract the stage rendering functions into a separate utility class that exposes static methods or a helper node
2. Extract the shop definitions data

Actually, given the complexity and risk of breaking the rendering, let me take a more conservative approach:
1. First, extract the shop-related rendering and logic into a separate file
2. Extract the NPC placement logic into a separate helper
3. Then gradually extract the stage rendering

But the most practical first step would be to split out the rendering helpers into a separate script. Let me create a new script `local_stage_renderer.gd` in the `world/` directory that handles all the stage drawing, and have `local_area_map.gd` delegate to it.

Actually, looking more carefully at the structure, the functions are all `_` prefixed private functions called from `_draw()`. The `_draw()` function structure is:

```
_draw() → _draw_base_tiles() + _draw_scene_background_wash() + _draw_side_view_stage() + _draw_portals() + _draw_scene_overlay() + _draw_region_overlay() + _draw_shop_overlay()
```

And most of the rendering functions access `self` properties like `size`, call `draw_*` methods, etc.

For a Node2D extension, the drawing functions need to be on the same node. So I can't easily extract them into a separate class without passing the node reference.

The better approach would be to split the non-rendering logic out:
1. Extract NPC placement/tile logic
2. Extract shop logic  
3. Extract portal label logic
4. Keep the rendering in the main file (since they need `draw_*` access)

Actually, the most pragmatic approach for a game in alpha is to just create a helper that gets passed a reference to the node and handles drawing.

Let me think about this differently. Rather than a risky refactor of the rendering code, I should focus on:

1. Extract data (SHOP_DEFINITIONS, constants) into data files
2. Extract non-rendering logic (NPC placement, shop entry/exit) into separate scripts
3. Leave the rendering code in place since it's tightly coupled with the node

Actually, looking at this more carefully, the rendering functions ARE the bulk of the file (about 3000+ lines out of 4200). The `_draw()` method calls many sub-functions. The practical approach is to NOT refactor the rendering code (it works), but to:

1. Create a `world/shop_manager.gd` for shop logic
2. Create a `world/npc_placement.gd` for NPC placement logic 
3. Keep `local_area_map.gd` focused on tile generation and rendering coordination

Let me start with extracting the shop definitions and logic. Actually, looking at the SHOP_DEFINITIONS, they're already partly in data files (region_shops.json). The main SHOP_DEFINITIONS in the script defines the shopkeeper names, descriptions, and default sell items.

Let me take a practical approach: create a helper class for shop logic extraction first, since it's the most self-contained part.

The single biggest win would be to extract the stage rendering into a separate scene/script. Let me create a `local_stage_renderer.gd` that handles the `_draw_side_view_stage()` pipeline and its sub-calls.

Actually, I think the best approach here is:

```json
{"file_path": "godot_project/scripts/world/npc_placement_helper.gd", "content": "extends RefCounted\nclass_name NpcPlacementHelper\n\n## NPC 放置辅助工具：从 local_area_map.gd 中提取的 NPC 生成与定位逻辑\n\nconst LOCAL_NPC_SPACING_STEPS := [6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1]\nconst LOCAL_NPC_ENTRY_CLEAR_RADIUS := 7\n\nvar map_width: int\nvar map_height: int\nvar tiles: Array\nvar current_region: Dictionary\nvar _occupied_npc_tiles: Array[Vector2i] = []\n\nfunc _init(width: int, height: int, region_tiles: Array, region: Dictionary) -> void:\n\tmap_width = width\n\tmap_height = height\n\ttiles = region_tiles\n\tcurrent_region = region\n\t_occupied_npc_tiles.clear()\n\nfunc clear() -> void:\n\t_occupied_npc_tiles.clear()\n\n## 计算 NPC 在局部地图中的出生瓦片位置\nfunc get_npc_tile(npc_data: Dictionary, index: int) -> Vector2i:\n\tvar role := str(npc_data.get(\"role\", \"\"))\n\tvar faction := str(npc_data.get(\"faction\", \"\"))\n\tvar fallback := Vector2i(map_width / 2 + index * 3, map_height - 4 - (index % 5))\n\tvar preferred := _role_anchor(npc_data, index, fallback)\n\treturn _claim_local_npc_tile(preferred, int(npc_data.get(\"id\", index)), index)\n\n## 获取 NPC 标记位置（用于小地图）\nfunc get_npc_markers(npc_nodes: Array) -> Array:\n\tvar markers: Array = []\n\tfor actor in npc_nodes:\n\t\tif not is_instance_valid(actor):\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\tmarkers.append({\n\t\t\t\"id\": actor.data.get(\"id\", 0),\n\t\t\t\"name\": actor.data.get(\"name\", \"\"),\n\t\t\t\"position\": actor.position,\n\t\t\t\"is_enemy\": actor.is_enemy() if actor.has_method(\"is_enemy\") else false,\n\t\t\t\"is_important\": _is_important_npc(actor.data),\n\t\t\t\"is_quest_target\": _is_quest_target(actor.data),\n\t\t})\n\treturn markers\n\nfunc _is_important_npc(npc_data: Dictionary) -> bool:\n\tvar role := str(npc_data.get(\"role\", \"\"))\n\treturn role in [\"掌门\", \"长老\", \"掌柜\", \"首领\"]\n\nfunc _is_quest_target(npc_data: Dictionary) -> bool:\n\tvar npc_id := int(npc_data.get(\"id\", -1))\n\tvar npc_name := str(npc_data.get(\"name\", \"\"))\n\tfor quest_id in GameState.active_quests:\n\t\tvar quest := GameData.get_quest(quest_id)\n\t\tif quest.is_empty():\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\tfor obj in quest.get(\"objectives\", []):\n\t\t\tif str(obj.get(\"type\", \"\")) == \"talk\" and (str(obj.get(\"target\", \"\")) == npc_name or int(obj.get(\"target_id\", -1)) == npc_id):\n\t\t\t\treturn true\n\treturn false\n\n## 按 NPC 角色分配锚点位置\nfunc _role_anchor(npc_data: Dictionary, index: int, fallback: Vector2i) -> Vector2i:\n\tvar role := str(npc_data.get(\"role\", \"\"))\n\tvar faction := str(npc_data.get(\"faction\", \"\"))\n\n\t# 掌门 → 居中偏后\n\tif role in [\"掌门\", \"长老\"]:\n\t\treturn _sect_anchor(index)\n\n\t# 掌柜 → 商铺入口附近\n\tif role == \"掌柜\" or npc_data.get(\"is_shop_keeper\", false):\n\t\treturn _merchant_anchor(index)\n\n\t# 敌人 → 边缘/外围\n\tif npc_data.get(\"is_enemy\", false) or int(npc_data.get(\"attack\", 0)) > 0:\n\t\treturn _edge_anchor(index)\n\n\t# 任务 NPC → 显眼位置\n\tif role == \"重要\":\n\t\treturn _story_anchor(index)\n\n\t# 服务类\n\tif role in [\"衙役\", \"捕快\", \"守卫\"]:\n\t\treturn _civic_anchor(index)\n\n\t# 平民\n\tif role in [\"路人\", \"农夫\", \"商贩\", \"行者\", \"书生\", \"医者\", \"工匠\"]:\n\t\treturn _civilian_anchor(index)\n\n\t# 安静角落\n\tif role in [\"僧侣\", \"道士\", \"隐士\", \"乞丐\"]:\n\t\treturn _quiet_anchor(index)\n\n\treturn fallback\n\nfunc _merchant_anchor(index: int) -> Vector2i:\n\tvar base := Vector2i(int(map_width * 0.36), int(map_height * 0.70))\n\tvar offset := Vector2i((index % 3) * 7, (index / 3) * -3)\n\treturn base + offset\n\nfunc _quiet_anchor(index: int) -> Vector2i:\n\tvar base := Vector2i(int(map_width * 0.54), int(map_height * 0.32))\n\tvar offset := Vector2i((index % 4) * 3 - 6, (index / 4) * -2)\n\treturn base + offset\n\nfunc _edge_anchor(index: int) -> Vector2i:\n\tvar side := index % 4\n\tvar base: Vector2i\n\tmatch side:\n\t\t0: base = Vector2i(3, int(map_height * 0.35))\n\t\t1: base = Vector2i(map_width - 5, int(map_height * 0.40))\n\t\t2: base = Vector2i(int(map_width * 0.20), 3)\n\t\t_: base = Vector2i(int(map_width * 0.72), map_height - 5)\n\tvar offset := Vector2i((index / 4) * 3, (index / 4) * 2)\n\treturn base + offset\n\nfunc _story_anchor(index: int) -> Vector2i:\n\tvar base := Vector2i(int(map_width * 0.48), int(map_height * 0.52))\n\tvar offset := Vector2i((index % 4) * 5 - 8, (index / 4) * -3)\n\treturn base + offset\n\nfunc _civic_anchor(index: int) -> Vector2i:\n\tvar base := Vector2i(int(map_width * 0.26), int(map_height * 0.45))\n\tvar offset := Vector2i((index % 3) * 8, (index / 3) * -2)\n\treturn base + offset\n\nfunc _civilian_anchor(index: int) -> Vector2i:\n\tvar base := Vector2i(int(map_width * 0.50), int(map_height * 0.56))\n\tvar offset := Vector2i((index % 6) * 5 - 12, (index / 6) * -2)\n\treturn base + offset\n\nfunc _sect_anchor(index: int) -> Vector2i:\n\tvar base := Vector2i(int(map_width * 0.48), int(map_height * 0.22))\n\tvar offset := Vector2i((index % 2) * 6 - 3, (index / 2) * -2)\n\treturn base + offset\n\n## 声明一个瓦片为 NPC 位置\nfunc _claim_local_npc_tile(preferred: Vector2i, npc_id: int, index: int) -> Vector2i:\n\tfor radius in LOCAL_NPC_SPACING_STEPS:\n\t\tvar candidates := _ring_candidates(preferred, radius, npc_id + index)\n\t\tcandidates.sort_custom(func(a: Vector2i, b: Vector2i) -> bool:\n\t\t\treturn a.distance_squared_to(preferred) < b.distance_squared_to(preferred))\n\t\tfor tile_pos in candidates:\n\t\t\tif _is_local_npc_tile_clear(tile_pos, radius):\n\t\t\t\tvar region_type := str(current_region.get(\"type\", \"\"))\n\t\t\t\tif _is_near_entry_tile(tile_pos) and region_type != \"shop\":\n\t\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t\t_occupied_npc_tiles.append(tile_pos)\n\t\t\t\treturn tile_pos\n\treturn preferred\n\nfunc _ring_candidates(center: Vector2i, radius: int, seed: int) -> Array[Vector2i]:\n\tvar candidates: Array[Vector2i] = []\n\tfor dx in range(-radius, radius + 1):\n\t\tfor dy in range(-radius, radius + 1):\n\t\t\tvar dst := maxi(abs(dx), abs(dy))\n\t\t\tif dst != radius and dst > 1:\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\tvar tile_pos := center + Vector2i(dx, dy)\n\t\t\tif tile_pos.x < 1 or tile_pos.x >= map_width - 1 or tile_pos.y < 1 or tile_pos.y >= map_height - 1:\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\tif dst < radius and dst > 1:\n\t\t\t\tif ((dx + dy + seed) % 3) != 0:\n\t\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\tcandidates.append(tile_pos)\n\treturn candidates\n\nfunc _is_local_npc_tile_clear(tile_pos: Vector2i, min_spacing: int) -> bool:\n\tfor occupied in _occupied_npc_tiles:\n\t\tif occupied.distance_squared_to(tile_pos) < min_spacing * min_spacing:\n\t\t\treturn false\n\treturn _is_tile_walkable(tile_pos)\n\nfunc _is_tile_walkable(tile_pos: Vector2i) -> bool:\n\tif tile_pos.x < 0 or tile_pos.y < 0 or tile_pos.x >= map_width or tile_pos.y >= map_height:\n\t\treturn false\n\tvar idx := tile_pos.y * map_width + tile_pos.x\n\tif idx < 0 or idx >= tiles.size():\n\t\treturn false\n\tvar tile_id := int(tiles[idx])\n\treturn tile_id not in [2, 3, 8, 9]  # 水、建筑、山、墙壁不可走\n\nfunc _is_near_entry_tile(tile_pos: Vector2i) -> bool:\n\tvar cx := map_width / 2\n\tvar cy := map_height - 3\n\treturn abs(tile_pos.x - cx) < 4 and abs(tile_pos.y - cy) < 3"}
```

Since I'm using NpcPlacementHelper in `_spawn_region_npcs`, the helper manages its own occupied tiles array. But the `occupied_npc_tiles` in local_area_map.gd is also used by other functions.

## 思考

world_map.gd has 1968 lines with about 40 functions. It has a similar structure to local_area_map.gd - mostly rendering functions with some logic mixed in. Let me analyze what can be split out:

1. **Map generation** (lines 425-610) - `generate_map()`, `_paint_*` methods - these are data/algorithmic and can be extracted
2. **NPC placement** (lines 630-769) - `spawn_npcs()`, `_world_npc_tile()`, etc. - similar to what I already extracted for local_area_map
3. **Rendering** (lines 852-1965) - all `_draw_*` methods - tightly coupled with the Node2D

The most practical extraction is the **map generation** logic. Let me create a `world_map_generator.gd` that contains the tile painting algorithms.

Actually, looking more carefully, there's already a `map_gen_system.gd` in the systems directory! Let me check what it does.

## 思考

The world_map map generation is somewhat complex, with biome painting, rivers, roads, etc. Let me extract the map generation logic into a separate ref-counted class. This is a clean extraction because:

1. The map generation doesn't depend on draw_* calls
2. It only operates on the `tiles` array and uses helper methods like `_set_tile`, `_get_tile`, `_fill_rect`
3. It can work with a simple reference to the world_map's data

However, I realize this is getting quite involved. For performance optimization, let me instead focus on a more impactful area - let me look at the performance concerns mentioned in the gap audit and see if there's something quick I can do.

Let me check the atmosphere layer's `_process` and how often it redraws, and look at the HUD performance concerns mentioned in the audit.

## 思考

Looking at the _process function (lines 291-304), the stage redraw is already rate-limited to `LOCAL_STAGE_REDRAW_INTERVAL = 1.0 / 18.0` (about 18fps for the painted rendering). The visual phase still updates every frame but that's cheap (just a float operation).

The main performance concern from the gap audit was about the `queue_redraw()` call frequency. At 18fps, that's reasonable.

Let me check if there's a more impactful optimization I can do. Let me look at how often the NPC ambient lines update, and maybe reduce the main menu backdrop loading.

Actually, let me take a look at the hud.gd since it was mentioned in the gap audit as having performance issues with the bottom shortcut bar.

Let me focus on something more concrete - let me check the file sizes and see what else can be done for the large file refactoring. Let me check GameData's structure more carefully.

Actually, you know what, let me just focus on a concrete deliverable: creating the WorldMapGenSystem to extract world map generation from world_map.gd. This is a clean, safe extraction that reduces world_map.gd by about 150 lines and makes the code more maintainable.

## 思考

The world map generation code extends from line 425 to about line 610 - that's about 185 lines that can be extracted. The generation functions are self-contained and only operate on the `tiles` array through methods like `_set_tile`, `_get_tile`, `_fill_rect`, `_paint_line`, `_rough_fill_rect`.

Let me create a WorldMapGenSystem that encapsulates this logic. I'll need to pass a reference to the world_map's tiles and helper methods.

Actually, looking at this more carefully, the generation functions call `_tile_seed(x, y)` which is also used by the rendering code (line 1731). So I can't just extract the generation without also moving the seed function. But `_tile_seed` is a simple deterministic hash - I can duplicate it in the generator.

Let me create the WorldMapGenSystem now.

## 思考

Now I have a clear picture. The world map generation code (lines 425-618) and the NPC spawning code (lines 630-759) are the two logical blocks I can extract. Let me create the WorldMapGenSystem first.

The generation code needs access to:
- `tiles` (2D array)
- `map_width`, `map_height` 
- `_set_tile`, `_get_tile`, `_fill_rect`, `_rough_fill_rect`, `_paint_line`, `_paint_mountain_biome`
- `_tile_seed` (simple hash)

I'll create it as a RefCounted class that takes the map data as parameters and generates tiles into an array that world_map.gd can then use.

Let me write it now.

The error is "Identifier 'WorldMapGenSystem' not declared in the current scope." This means the class is not known in world_map.gd. The issue is that `WorldMapGenSystem` is defined in `scripts/systems/world_map_gen_system.gd` with `class_name WorldMapGenSystem`, but it might not be autoloaded and I need to preload it.

Wait, in Godot 4, `class_name` makes the class globally available. But it's in `scripts/systems/` - let me check if the script is properly recognized by Godot. Maybe I need to preload it explicitly.

Actually, in Godot 4, `class_name` should make a class globally visible. But sometimes Godot's script parser can't find newly created classes until the editor opens them. For headless mode, I may need to use a preload.

## 思考

I see an important issue: `atmosphere_layer.gd` line 32 calls `queue_redraw()` **every frame** in `_process`. This means the entire atmosphere layer (which draws weather, time tints, region tints, depth haze, vignette, seasonal tints, etc.) is redrawing every frame.

## 思考

I see the issue - atmosphere_layer's `_process` calls `queue_redraw()` every frame, even though many of its visual effects (region tint, season tint, weather particles) only need to update a few times per second for smooth animation.

Looking at what the atmosphere layer does:
1. `_draw_region_tint` - static, only needs update on region change
2. `_draw_season_tint` - static, only needs update on season change
3. `_draw_time_tint` - changes hourly, but could be on-demand
4. `_draw_weather` - needs phase-based animation (rain drops falling, etc.)
5. `_draw_region_motif` - needs phase-based animation (petals falling, mist drifting)
6. `_draw_depth_haze` - needs phase-based animation
7. `_draw_vignette` - static, only needs update on time change
8. `_update_ambient_audio` - not a draw call, handled separately

The phase-based effects (rain, snow, petals, mist) need periodic redraws, but not at 60fps. I should throttle this to around 15-20fps (similar to what local_area_map.gd does).

Let me add a rate limit to the _process redraw.

4. **Content Depth (P1)**
   - Enough content for 5+ hours of gameplay
   - Side quests, exploration rewards

5. **Audio Completeness (P1)**
   - Already have the system, need more variety

6. **Export Readiness (P2)**

```json
{"file_path": "godot_project/scripts/autoload/audio_manager.gd", "new_string": "const SETTINGS_PATH := \"user://settings.cfg\"\nconst SETTINGS_SECTION := \"audio\"\n\nfunc _ready() -> void:\n\t_setup_buses()\n\t_setup_players()\n\t_load_settings()\n\nfunc _load_settings() -> void:\n\tvar cfg := ConfigFile.new()\n\tif cfg.load(SETTINGS_PATH) != OK:\n\t\treturn\n\t_master_muted = bool(cfg.get_value(SETTINGS_SECTION, \"master_muted\", false))\n\t_bgm_volume = clampf(float(cfg.get_value(SETTINGS_SECTION, \"bgm_volume\", DEFAULT_BGM_VOLUME)), 0.0, 1.0)\n\t_sfx_volume = clampf(float(cfg.get_value(SETTINGS_SECTION, \"sfx_volume\", DEFAULT_SFX_VOLUME)), 0.0, 1.0)\n\t_ambient_volume = clampf(float(cfg.get_value(SETTINGS_SECTION, \"ambient_volume\", DEFAULT_AMBIENT_VOLUME)), 0.0, 1.0)\n\tvar master_idx := AudioServer.get_bus_index(BUS_MASTER)\n\tif master_idx >= 0:\n\t\tAudioServer.set_bus_mute(master_idx, _master_muted)\n\tAudioServer.set_bus_volume_db(AudioServer.get_bus_index(BUS_BGM), linear_to_db(_bgm_volume))\n\tAudioServer.set_bus_volume_db(AudioServer.get_bus_index(BUS_SFX), linear_to_db(_sfx_volume))\n\tAudioServer.set_bus_volume_db(AudioServer.get_bus_index(BUS_AMBIENT), linear_to_db(_ambient_volume))\n\nfunc _save_settings() -> void:\n\tvar cfg := ConfigFile.new()\n\tcfg.set_value(SETTINGS_SECTION, \"master_muted\", _master_muted)\n\tcfg.set_value(SETTINGS_SECTION, \"bgm_volume\", _bgm_volume)\n\tcfg.set_value(SETTINGS_SECTION, \"sfx_volume\", _sfx_volume)\n\tcfg.set_value(SETTINGS_SECTION, \"ambient_volume\", _ambient_volume)\n\tcfg.save(SETTINGS_PATH)", "old_string": "func _ready() -> void:\n\t_setup_buses()\n\t_setup_players()"}
```

```
13: static func _kill_existing(control: Control) -> void:

15: 		var old: Tween = control.get_meta("_panel_tween")
16: 		if old != null and old.is_valid():

19: static func _prepare_pivot(control: Control) -> void:
20: 	var s := control.size

22: 		s = DisplayServer.window_get_size()
23: 	control.pivot_offset = s * 0.5

25: static func open(control: Control, duration: float = OPEN_DURATION) -> void:
26: 	if control == null:

28: 	_kill_existing(control)
29: 	control.show()
30: 	_prepare_pivot(control)
31: 	control.modulate.a = 0.0

33: 	control.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
34: 	var t := control.create_tween()
35: 	t.set_parallel(true)
36: 	t.tween_property(control, "modulate:a", 1.0, duration).set_ease(OPEN_EASE).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUAD)
37: 	t.tween_property(control, "scale", Vector2.ONE, duration).set_ease(OPEN_EASE).set_trans(OPEN_TRANS)

44: 	_prepare_pivot(control)
45: 	control.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE

47: 	t.set_parallel(true)

49: 	t.tween_property(control, "scale", CLOSE_SCALE_TO, duration).set_ease(CLOSE_EASE).set_trans(CLOSE_TRANS)
```

## 思考

I see - NPCs don't have a `region_id` field. Instead, they have `pos_x` and `pos_y` which are tile coordinates on the world map. The game uses `GameData.get_region_at_tile(tile)` to determine which region an NPC belongs to.

This means the NPC assignment to regions is done dynamically based on world map coordinates. Let me check if the NPCs in the qinghe area (tiles around 28-31, 14-17) are properly assigned to the qinghe region.

Let me check the region data to see the qinghe region's tile bounds.

The qinghe region's rect is [26, 13, 9, 7], which means:
- x: 26 to 35 (26+9)
- y: 13 to 20 (13+7)

Let me check which NPCs have coordinates in this range. The NPCs I saw earlier:
- 平阿四: (28, 15) ✅ in qinghe
- 店小二: (29, 15) ✅ in qinghe
- 阿青: (27, 17) ✅ in qinghe
- 厨师: (29, 16) ✅ in qinghe
- 屠夫: (27, 15) ✅ in qinghe
- 小商贩: (31, 17) ✅ in qinghe

So these are properly assigned to qinghe via the coordinate system. My earlier check with `region_id == 'qinghe'` was wrong - NPCs don't use a `region_id` field, they use tile coordinates that are matched against region rects.

This confirms the game logic is correct. No issue here.

## 思考

These generators are highly detailed and region-specific. Each generator is about 300+ lines of custom drawing code. Creating a unified generator for all 46 remaining regions would be extremely complex.

Let me take a more practical approach. Instead of writing individual generators for each region, let me:

1. Look at all the existing generators to understand the common visual patterns
2. Create a batch script that uses the stage profile system already in the game
3. The game already has `stage_visual_profile.gd` and `stage_backdrop_renderer.gd` which handles programmatic stage rendering at runtime

Actually, looking at this from a practical standpoint, the game already has a `stage_backdrop_renderer.gd` that does programmatic stage rendering at runtime. The 27 existing regions have custom-generated PNG files, but the remaining 46 regions already use programmatic rendering at runtime (via the `_draw_side_view_stage()` function in local_area_map.gd). The game runs and looks fine - the regions just don't have pre-generated PNG backgrounds.

The gap is that these regions use runtime programmatic drawing instead of pre-generated high-quality PNGs. The programmatic drawing is functional but less visually appealing.

For a commercial release, the ideal approach would be to create generators for all 46 remaining regions. But creating 46 detailed generators would be extremely time-consuming.

A more practical approach would be to:
1. Create a single generic generator that produces reasonable stage backgrounds based on terrain/region type
2. Not as detailed as the custom ones, but better than the runtime fallback
3. Update the stage_layer_assets.json to point to the new files

Let me create a generic stage generator that produces reasonable backgrounds for any terrain/region type combination. This will be a significant improvement over the runtime fallback.

Let me write the unified generator now.

TERRAIN_PALETTES[\"default\"]\n\n\ndef vertical_gradient(size, top_rgb, bottom_rgb):\n    w, h = size\n    img = Image.new(\"RGBA\", size, (0, 0, 0, 0))\n    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)\n    for y in range(h):\n        t = y / max(1, h - 1)\n        r = round(top_rgb[0] + (bottom_rgb[0] - top_rgb[0]) * t)\n        g = round(top_rgb[1] + (bottom_rgb[1] - top_rgb[1]) * t)\n        b = round(top_rgb[2] + (bottom_rgb[2] - top_rgb[2]) * t)\n        draw.line([(0, y), (w, y)], fill=rgba(r, g, b, 255))\n    return img\n\n\ndef add_glow(image, center, radius, color, alpha):\n    glow = Image.new(\"RGBA\", image.size, (0, 0, 0, 0))\n    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(glow)\n    cx, cy = center\n    draw.ellipse(box(cx - radius, cy - radius, cx + radius, cy + radius), fill=rgba(*color, alpha))\n    glow = glow.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(max(2, round(radius * 0.42))))\n    image.alpha_composite(glow)\n\n\ndef draw_mountain_band(draw, w, h, base_y, height, color, seed_str):\n    rng = random.Random(seed_str)\n    points = [(0, base_y + height * 0.38)]\n    steps = 16\n    for i in range(steps + 1):\n        x = w * i / steps\n        y = base_y - height * (0.34 + rng.random() * 0.42) + math.sin(i * 1.19) * height * 0.08\n        points.append((x, y))\n    points.append((w, base_y + height * 0.38))\n    draw.polygon([(round(px), round(py)) for px, py in points], fill=color)\n\n\ndef draw_forest_band(draw, w, h, base_y, height, color, seed_str, trunk_color):\n    rng = random.Random(seed_str)\n    draw_mountain_band(draw, w, h, base_y, height, color, seed_str)\n    for i in range(32):\n        x = rng.uniform(0, w)\n        trunk_h = rng.uniform(height * 0.3, height * 0.7)\n        tw = max(2, rng.uniform(2, 5))\n        draw.line([xy(x, base_y), xy(x, base_y - trunk_h)], fill=trunk_color, width=round(tw))\n        for branch in range(3):\n            bx = x + rng.uniform(-20, 20)\n            by = base_y - trunk_h * rng.uniform(0.4, 0.9)\n            draw.line([xy(bx, by), xy(bx + rng.uniform(-40, 40), by - rng.uniform(10, 30))],\n                       fill=rgba(*color[:3], round(color[3] * 0.6)), width=1)\n\n\ndef draw_building_row(draw, w, h, y, count, accent, alpha, seed_str):\n    rng = random.Random(seed_str)\n    spacing = w / (count + 1)\n    for i in range(count):\n        x = spacing * (i + 1) + rng.uniform(-spacing * 0.15, spacing * 0.15)\n        bw = rng.uniform(48, 96)\n        bh = rng.uniform(60, 120)\n        draw.rectangle(box(x - bw / 2, y - bh, x + bw / 2, y), fill=rgba(*accent, round(alpha * rng.uniform(0.6, 0.9))))\n        draw.rectangle(box(x - bw / 4, y - bh * 0.35, x + bw / 4, y - bh * 0.2), fill=rgba(*accent, round(alpha * 0.8)))\n        roof_top = y - bh\n        draw.polygon([(round(x - bw * 0.7), round(roof_top + bh * 0.12)),\n                       (round(x), round(roof_top - bh * 0.15)),\n                       (round(x + bw * 0.7), round(roof_top + bh * 0.12))],\n                      fill=rgba(*accent, round(alpha * 0.7)))\n\n\n# ─── 图层生成 ─────────────────────────────────────────\n\ndef generate_floor(size, terrain, accent, water_color, rng):\n    w, h = size\n    img = Image.new(\"RGBA\", size, (0, 0, 0, 0))\n    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)\n    ground_top = h * 0.52\n\n    is_water = any(w in terrain for w in [\"river\", \"lake\", \"canal\", \"water\", \"marsh\", \"tide\", \"ford\", \"waterway\"])\n    is_mountain = any(w in terrain for w in [\"mountain\", \"cliff\", \"pass\", \"gorge\"])\n    is_desert = \"desert\" in terrain\n    is_snow = \"snow\" in terrain\n    is_forest = any(w in terrain for w in [\"forest\", \"bamboo\", \"garden\"])\n\n    # Ground\n    if is_water:\n        draw.rectangle(box(0, ground_top, w, h), fill=rgba(*water_color, 180))\n        for i in range(30):\n            y = ground_top + rng.uniform(0, h - ground_top)\n            draw.line([(0, y), (w, y + rng.uniform(-10, 10))], fill=rgba(*water_color, round(rng.uniform(30, 80))), width=1)\n    elif is_snow:\n        draw.rectangle(box(0, ground_top, w, h), fill=rgba(210, 205, 200, 255))\n        for i in range(20):\n            y = ground_top + rng.uniform(0, h - ground_top)\n            draw.line([(0, y), (w, y + rng.uniform(-5, 5))], fill=rgba(225, 220, 215, round(rng.uniform(40, 90))), width=rng.randint(2, 5))\n    else:\n        draw.rectangle(box(0, ground_top, w, h), fill=rgba(*accent, 255))\n        for i in range(40):\n            y = ground_top + rng.uniform(0, h - ground_top)\n            alpha = rng.uniform(20, 60)\n            draw.line([(0, y), (w, y)], fill=rgba(*accent, round(alpha)), width=rng.randint(1, 3))\n\n    # Path\n    if not is_water and not is_mountain:\n        path_color = rgba(*accent, 80)\n        draw.rectangle(box(w * 0.25, ground_top, w * 0.75, h), fill=path_color)\n        for i in range(10):\n            y = ground_top + (h - ground_top) * i / 9\n            draw.line([(w * 0.25, y), (w * 0.75, y + rng.uniform(-8, 8))], fill=rgba(*accent, round(rng.uniform(20, 40))), width=1)\n\n    # Water reflection for water regions\n    if is_water:\n        for i in range(15):\n            x = rng.uniform(0, w)\n            y = ground_top + rng.uniform(0, h - ground_top)\n            highlight = rgba(200, 220, 230, round(rng.uniform(20, 50)))\n            draw.line([(x, y), (x + rng.uniform(20, 60), y + rng.uniform(-5, 5))], fill=highlight, width=1)\n\n    return img\n\n\ndef generate_midground(size, terrain, accent, top_sky, region_type, rng):\n    w, h = size\n    img = Image.new(\"RGBA\", size, (0, 0, 0, 0))\n    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)\n\n    ground_top = h * 0.52\n    is_mountain = any(w in terrain for w in [\"mountain\", \"cliff\", \"pass\", \"gorge\", \"valley\"])\n    is_forest = any(w in terrain for w in [\"forest\", \"bamboo\", \"garden\"])\n    is_water = any(w in terrain for w in [\"river\", \"lake\", \"canal\", \"water\", \"marsh\", \"tide\", \"ford\", \"waterway\"])\n    is_city = region_type == \"city\"\n    is_town = region_type == \"town\"\n    is_sect = region_type == \"sect\"\n    is_snow = \"snow\" in terrain\n\n    # Distant mountains/forest\n    if is_mountain:\n        for band in range(2):\n            by = ground_top - h * (0.12 + band * 0.08)\n            bh = h * (0.10 + band * 0.06)\n            dim = 0.5 + band * 0.3\n            c = rgba(round(top_sky[0] * dim), round(top_sky[1] * dim), round(top_sky[2] * dim), round(120 - band * 30))\n            draw_mountain_band(draw, w, h, by, bh, c, f\"mtn-{band}\")\n    elif is_forest:\n        for band in range(2):\n            by = ground_top - h * (0.10 + band * 0.06)\n            bh = h * (0.08 + band * 0.04)\n            green = rgba(round(accent[0] * 0.5), is_city or is_town:\n        draw_building_row(draw, w, h, ground_top, 6, accent, 160, \"buildings\")\n        draw_building_row(draw, w, h, ground_top - h * 0.08, 4, top_sky, 100, \"bg-buildings\")\n\n    # Sect buildings\n    if is_sect:\n        draw_building_row(draw, w, h, ground_top, 3, accent, 200, \"sect-buildings\")\n        # Gate\n        gate_x = w // 2\n        draw.rectangle(box(gate_x - 40, ground_top - 120, gate_x + 40, ground_top), fill=rgba(*accent, 200))\n        draw.rectangle(box(gate_x - 25, ground_top - 65, gate_x + 25, ground_top), fill=rgba(0, 0, 0, 120))\n        # Roof\n        draw.polygon([(gate_x - 60, ground_top - 90), (gate_x, ground_top - 140), (gate_x + 60, ground_top - 90)],\n                      fill=rgba(*accent, 220) if not is_snow else rgba(200, 195, 190, 220))\n        if is_snow:\n            draw.rectangle(box(0, ground_top, w, h), fill=rgba(200, 195, 190, 60))\n\n    # Trees for forest/garden\n    if is_forest or (is_town and not is_water):\n        for i in range(8):\n            x = rng.uniform(0, w)\n            trunk_h = rng.uniform(80, 160)\n            tw = max(2, rng.uniform(3, 6))\n            draw.line([xy(x, ground_top), xy(x, ground_top - trunk_h)],\n                       fill=rgba(80, 60, 40, round(rng.uniform(120, 200))), width=round(tw))\n            crown_r = rng.uniform(24, 48)\n            draw.ellipse(box(x - crown_r, ground_top - trunk_h - crown_r * 0.6, x + crown_r, ground_top - trunk_h + crown_r * 0.4),\n                          fill=rgba(round(accent[0] * 0.6), round(accent[1] * 0.8), round(accent[2] * 0.6), round(rng.uniform(80, 160))))\n\n    return img\n\n\ndef generate_foreground(size, terrain, accent, rng):\n    w, h = size\n    img = Image.new(\"RGBA\", size, (0, 0, 0, 0))\n    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)\n\n    is_water = any(w in terrain for w in [\"river\", \"lake\", \"canal\", \"water\", \"marsh\", \"tide\", \"ford\"])\n    is_forest = any(w in terrain for w in [\"forest\", \"bamboo\", \"garden\"])\n    is_snow = \"snow\" in terrain\n    is_desert = \"desert\" in terrain\n    is_mountain = any(w in terrain for w in [\"mountain\", \"cliff\", \"pass\", \"gorge\"])\n\n    # Bottom edge darker\n    draw.rectangle(box(0, h * 0.88, w, h), fill=rgba(*accent, 80))\n\n    # Foreground trees\n    if is_forest:\n        for i in range(5):\n            x = rng.uniform(-30, w + 30)\n            trunk_h = rng.uniform(120, 200)\n            tw = max(3, rng.uniform(4, 8))\n            draw.line([xy(x, h), xy(x, h - is_mountain:\n        for i in range(3):\n            x = rng.uniform(-20, w + 20)\n            draw.line([xy(x, h), xy(x + rng.uniform(-10, 10), h - rng.uniform(100, 160))],\n                       fill=rgba(*accent, round(rng.uniform(100, 160))), width=round(rng.uniform(4, 10)))\n    elif is_desert:\n        for i in range(8):\n            x = rng.uniform(-20, w + 20)\n            dh = \"\"\"为指定区域生成三层舞台背景，返回层路径字典\"\"\"\n    palette = _lookup_palette(terrain)\n    top_sky, bottom_sky, ground, accent, water_color = palette\n\n    rng = random.Random(f\"{SEED_BASE}-{region_id}\")\n    slug = f\"{region_id}_batch_v1\"\n\n    floor_img = generate_floor(SIZE, terrain, accent, water_color, rng)\n    mid_img = generate_midground(SIZE, terrain, accent, top_sky, region_type, rng)\n print(f\"需要生成: {len(missing)}\")\n    print()\n\n    generated = []\n    for i, region in enumerate(missing):\n        rid = region[\"id\"]\n        terrain = region.get(\"terrain\", \"plain\")\n \".join(generated))\n\n    # Print summary statistics\n    total_images = len(generated) * 3\n    print(f\"总共生成 {total_images} 个 PNG 文件\")\n\n    # Check file sizes\n    small_files = []\n    for rid in generated:\n        for layer in [\"floor\", \"midground\", \"foreground\"]:\n            path_str = stage_assets.get(rid, {}).get(layer, \"\")\n            if path_str:\n                path = Path(str(path_str).replace(\"res://\", str(PROJECT) + \"/\"))\n                if path.exists():\n                    size_kb = path.stat().st_size / 1024\n                    if size_kb < 5:\n                        small_files.append((rid, layer, size_kb))\n\n    if small_files:\n        print(\"\\n⚠️ 小文件警告（可能生成有误）:\")\n        for rid, layer, size in small_files[:10]:\n            print(f\"  {rid}/{layer}: {size:.1f}KB\")\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()"}

## 思考

The validation is comparing the scene background sizes (640x360) with the stage layer sizes (1672x941) and finding a mismatch. I need to resize the scene backgrounds to match the stage layer dimensions. The existing region backgrounds (scene_background_assets.json) reference 640x360 images, but the stage layers are 1672x941.

Let me check how the existing 27 regions handle this - maybe they don't have this check or the backgrounds are already the right size.

## 思考

There are lots of validation errors because the quests reference NPCs that don't exist in the NPC database (generic NPCs like "山贼", "水匪", "渔夫", etc.). I need to fix these by either:

1. Adding the generic NPCs to the npcs.json
2. Using existing NPC names instead

For the game to work, these quests need to match NPCs that players can actually interact with. The combat system can handle generic enemy types like "山贼" and "水匪" since enemies are generated at combat time, not from static NPCs. But the validation script checks against the static NPC list.

Let me fix the quests to:
1. Use existing NPC names for talk objectives
2. Change giver names to existing NPC names
3. Keep kill/collect objectives as-is (they don't need to match NPCs byte-for-byte, the game uses them as combat encounter labels)

Wait, looking more carefully at the validation script, it checks:
- `giver` field against NPC names
- `target` in objectives against NPC names  
- `kill` targets against NPC names

But the combat system generates enemies on the fly (like "山贼", "水匪") - they don't need to exist in the static npcs.json as NPC definitions. The validation script is being overly strict for kill targets and givers.

Let me fix the quests to use existing NPC names where possible, and update the validation script to not check kill targets so strictly.

Actually, a simpler approach is to just fix the quests to reference existing NPCs. Let me update the quests to use NPCs that exist in the data.

## 助手

Quest NPC 引用不匹配。让我修复——使用现有 NPC 名称

## 工具 · bash

```json
{"description": "Fix quest NPC references", "command": "cd godot_project && python3 << 'PYEOF'\nimport json\n\nwith open('data/quests.json') as f:\n    quests = json.load(f)\n\nwith open('data/npcs.json') as f:\n    npcs = json.load(f)\n\nnpc_names = set(n.get('name', '') for n in npcs)\n\n# Fix givers and talk targets to use valid NPC names\nfixes = {\n    \"西域商人\": \"阎商\",\n    \"猎户\": \"猎人\",\n    \"渔夫\": \"渔夫\",  # keep\n    \"船夫\": \"船夫\",\n    \"老者\": \"老人\",\n    \"工匠\": \"工匠\",\n    \"信使\": \"信使\",\n    \"古董商\": \"古董商\",\n    \"酒坊老板\": \"掌柜\",\n    \"布庄老板\": \"掌柜\",\n    \"酒商\": \"酒商\",\n    \"农夫\": \"农夫\",\n    \"教书先生\": \"教书先生\",\n    \"药农\": \"药农\",\n    \"老兵\": \"老兵\",\n    \"香客\": \"香客\",\n    \"寻宝人\": \"寻宝人\",\n    \"采药人\": \"采药人\",\n    \"画师\": \"画师\",\n    \"船家\": \"船家\",\n    \"茶农\": \"茶农\",\n    \"游人\": \"游人\",\n    \"采莲女\": \"采莲女\",\n    \"钓翁\": \"钓翁\",\n    \"考古者\": \"考古者\",\n    \"船娘\": \"船娘\",\n    \"书生\": \"书生\",\n    \"云游僧\": \"云游僧\",\n}\n\n# First check which names actually exist\nprint(\"检查NPC名称存在性:\")\nfor orig, replacement in list(fixes.items()):\n    if replacement not in npc_names:\n        print(f\"  {orig}→{replacement}: ❌ 不存在\")\n    else:\n        print(f\"  {orig}→{replacement}: ✅\")\n\n# Fix quests\nfixed = 0\nfor q in quests:\n    giver = q.get('giver', '')\n    if giver in fixes:\n        replacement = fixes[giver]\n        if replacement in npc_names:\n            q['giver'] = replacement\n            fixed += 1\n    \n    for obj in q.get('objectives', []):\n        if obj.get('type') == 'talk':\n            target = obj.get('target', '')\n            if target in fixes:\n                replacement = fixes[target]\n                if replacement in npc_names:\n                    obj['target'] = replacement\n                    fixed += 1\n\nwith open('data/quests.json', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:\n    json.dump(quests, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)\n\nprint(f\"\\n修复了 {fixed} 个引用\")\nPYEOF"}
```
